Part 3 / Chapter 15.

...tion <note>This fragment likely completes the word "disposition" or "imagination" from the previous page.</note>, in the eternal, initial ground; this is not formed along with the outer animal **constellation** <term>Constellation</term> <note>The astrological alignment that Böhme believes governs the physical and "animal" parts of a human, but not the deepest part of the soul.</note>. For the **Soul’s Disposition** <term>Seelische Scientz</term> <note>original: "Scientz"; from the Latin 'scientia,' here meaning the soul's innate knowledge or essential tendency.</note> has a unique form, like a magical **source of fiery quality** <term>Feuer-Quall</term> <note>A Böhmean term combining 'Quelle' (source) and 'Qual' (torment/quality), describing the soul as a dynamic spring of energy.</note>, and in life it separates itself into the figure of the body. Within it lies the ground of eternal nature, capable of both good and evil. For it is the cause of both fire and light, yet it lies trapped, hard and heavy, in sins. For here, **original sins** <term>Erb-Sünden</term> lie in the **center** <term>Centro</term> of nature, where the devil has gained a seat. Likewise, here lie the inherited sins from parents and grandparents, like an evil poison, of which **GOD** says He would punish them in the children unto the third and fourth generation. Here also lie the parents' good deeds and **GOD’s** blessing, which pass over to the children. These properties also form themselves into a figure according to their kind; with this, the soul shapes itself into an image of an angel or a devil. And here lies the heavy ground where the **Election of GOD** <note>The theological concept of predestination or 'Gnadenwahl'.</note> sees what kind of angel will emerge there. However, no final conclusion is made regarding it, for the **Gift of Grace** <term>Gnaden-Geschencke</term> stands in the inner ground and attaches itself to the **center of knowledge** <term>Centro der Scientz</term> of the **Unground** <term>Ungrund</term> <note>The "bottomless" or "groundless" state of the Divine before it manifests into specific forms; the absolute freedom of God.</note> of the soul, as the will of the eternal Father. Here **Christ** prays for the poor fallen soul, as the Scripture says, for the soul lies in the bonds of **GOD’s** wrath and is hardened in its sins. Here life draws itself through death and sifts to see if any good little spark is within that might be capable of receiving **Divine Power**; if so, it is drawn. For just as **Christ** desires to be manifest, so the **wrath** <term>Grimm</term> of nature also desires to be manifest. Thus these two **purposes** <term>Fürsätze</term> stand in conflict within the **formed Word** <note>Creation as the spoken expression of God.</note> over humanity, as over **GOD’s** image. The Kingdom of Grace wants to possess it and reveal itself in it; likewise, the Kingdom of Nature in the wrath of the fire and in its **differentiation** <note>original: "Schiedlichkeit"; the state of being divided into conflicting parts.</note> also wants to have it and reveal itself in it. And both of these lie in the formed Word: namely, the Father’s property in the wrath

<column-break/>

and the Son’s property of love in the light.

->*The Election of Grace, Chapter 8. Paragraphs 39 — 47.*<- <note>original: "Gnaden-W."</note>

Therefore, dear brothers, understand it this way: on one part, **Christ** is the Divine **Purpose** <term>Fürsatz</term> and Will of Grace; whoever is born from this and puts Him on is "chosen" and a child of grace. And on the other part is the Purpose of **GOD**, the fiery will of the soul from the center of eternal nature, where light and darkness separate. There, one part goes into the center of darkness—namely, the **coarse illusory sulfur** <term>Phantastische Sulphur</term> <note>In Böhme's alchemy, 'Sulphur' represents the active, driving spirit; 'phantastic' refers to the false, earthly, or illusory nature.</note>; but the subtle, pure part goes into the light. Into whichever side the **knowledge** <term>Scientz</term> of the groundless will towards nature separates itself, therein it becomes a creature, either in the light or in the darkness. The Purpose of **GOD** proceeds entirely from the soul’s ground, for the inner ground of the soul is the Divine Nature of the eternally-speaking Word and is neither evil nor good. But in the **differentiation** <note>original: "Schiedlichkeit"</note> of the fire—that is, in the ignited life of the soul—that same will separates itself into either **GOD’s** wrath or **GOD’s** fire of love. And this happens in no other way than through the quality of that which the **Soul’s Essence** <term>Seelische Essentz</term> is within itself: it is itself its own ground for evil or good, for it is the **center** of **GOD**, where **GOD’s** love and wrath lie unrolled in one ground. Thus, this is the Purpose of **GOD**: that He desires to reveal Himself through the spoken, formed Word (of which the soul is a being in the speaking of differentiation). There, the coarseness hardens itself in the inherited as well as the actual, self-contained abominations. For there is no other will of **GOD** in the essence of this world than that which becomes manifest from the eternal ground in fire and light, as well as in darkness. The soul is chosen within itself as a child of grace when it is born of **Christ**, out of the **Divine Being** <term>Göttlichen Ente</term> <note>original: "Ente"; from the Latin 'ens', meaning essence or being.</note>, which is the sole Purpose of Divine Grace, from which **GOD’s** grace becomes manifest in the soul; and it is also in itself...

18. **Question:** How then shall I reconcile the examples of Holy Scripture with the foundation laid by the author?
**Answer:** Regarding the examples / which the <term>Election-Choosers</term> <note>original: "Gnaden-Wähler"; those who believe in strict predestination, such as Calvinists.</note> cite to maintain their error / the author does not consider **Cain, Ishmael, Esau** and the like to be those / whom **GOD** has surrendered to eternal damnation / to the <term>judgment of hardening</term> <note>original: "Gerichte der Verstockung"; the theological state where a heart is closed to grace.</note> / indeed, they cannot even be examples of an infinite, eternal rejection. For **Cain** could still have ruled over sin. **Ishmael** was saved from death by an Angel of **GOD**, and inherited a blessing and many goods from his father **Abraham**. **Esau** was likewise blessed, and provided with great fatness, power, and the strength of the earth by **Isaac**, so that they were not examples of damnation, but were **Prefigures** of those who walk according to the flesh and establish righteousness according to the flesh; because all three had the right of the **First-Birth** according to the flesh. In contrast, **Abel, Isaac, and Jacob** were prefigures of **Christ** and His members, who do not walk according to the flesh, and who did not have the right of the first-birth according to the flesh, but rather according to the **Spirit**, and according to the grace of the **Word of Promise**. Just as **Abel, Isaac, and Jacob** were not without sin in the flesh, so it is not to be thought that **Cain, Ishmael, and Esau** were without the grace of the promise. Therefore we say, as the **LORD** makes it known, that whoever wishes to rightly read and understand the history of the Old Testament, must place two images before themselves: the **outer Adam** / and the **inner Christ** / and transform these two images into one / then he may understand everything / that **Moses** and the **Prophets** spoke in the Spirit. # The XVI. Chapter.
## Of the Birth of Cain and Abel / their Sacrifice and Worship / and what followed thereafter.

->1. Question.<-
->How did Eve, the Mother of all Living, bear Cain and Abel?<-

->Answer.<-

In the two briefly preceding chapters concerning the propagation of mankind and the election of grace, we have extensively proven how sin—and through sin, death—became active in man as soon as he ate from the Tree of Knowledge. Likewise, the Word of Promise became powerful in man as soon as GOD spoke it from His heart into man. The enmity and the struggle between Light and Darkness, Love and Wrath, Death and Life, began immediately, as each side desired to have the upper hand. Because Adam and Eve entered into the spirit of this world, they lived in two-foldness: they lived in the holy element before GOD in hope; but they also lived in the "out-birth" of the four elements, which reach into the outermost realm—the kingdom of <term>Grimmigkeit</term> <note>original: "Grimmigkeit." This term refers to the fierce, dark, or "wrathful" quality of nature that exists apart from God's light.</note>. Therefore, two kinds of children were born from them: namely, a mocker and a pious man. If one seeks the true ground of this deeply, this is the reality: Eve was the child within Adam’s <term>Matrix</term> <note>original: "Matrix." In Böhme's thought, this is the creative womb or the feminine principle of nature from which all things are brought forth.</note>; had Adam not been overcome by the spirit of the world, he would have brought her forth from himself in great discipline and holiness. However, because Adam's <term>Matrix</term> was impregnated by the spirit of this world, GOD had to build a fleshly woman out of it. She, in turn, was so fleeting in her first fruit and infected by the devil, as was the <term>Limbus</term> <note>original: "Limbus." This refers to the masculine "seed" or the essential spiritual-physical extract from which man was formed.</note> in Adam. Therefore, they bore such a pious child who looked only toward greed, just as Eve did; she wanted to be equal to GOD. Certainly, Adam was also concerned with this, otherwise he would not have entered into the spirit of this world. Thus was also their son Cain; he thought he was the Lord on earth and did not grant his brother the right to be anything at all.

<margin>Principles 20. 91. 92. 93. <note>Refers to Böhme’s book "The Three Principles of the Divine Essence."</note></margin>

<column-break/>

->2. Question. What special thing did Eve see in Cain, that she took him for the man, the LORD?<-

->Answer.<-

The Word of Promise regarding the Serpent-Treader <note>A reference to the prophecy in Genesis 3:15 that the offspring of the woman would crush the serpent's head.</note> lay so deeply in her mind that she believed the first one to come would be the one to do it—namely, to crush the serpent’s head, reclaim and possess the Kingdom, wrest the sword from the hands of the Cherub, separate the curse from the earth, reopen Paradise and its power within the creature, and return man to the state of perfect glory, joy, and delight. The disciples of Christ thought similarly, that He would establish an earthly kingdom in which they might live as princes in great glory; but both were deceived. In Eve’s <term>Matrix</term>, as mentioned before, the devil’s desire and the serpent's earthly <term>Ens</term> <note>original: "Ens." A Latin term for "being" or "essence." Böhme uses it to describe the spiritual substance that gives rise to physical reality.</note> had swung themselves upward and seized the first seed in that desire. Now, the Kingdom of GOD rightfully belonged to the first man; but because he forfeited it, the first Adam had to be sacrificed to the earth, and likewise his first seed to the Wrath. After this first seed, Abel pressed forward in the Holy Covenant and offered his sweet blood to the Wrath on behalf of the sinful seed, so that the Wrath might lower its flames and let the first birth pass through the blood of the other. The first birth became a murderer, signifying the devil in man; the other, however, was a sacrifice for the first, so that the "Wrath-Devil" in the first Adam might be reconciled in the sacrifice of the second.

<margin>Mysterium Magnum 26. 42. 44. <note>Böhme's commentary on Genesis.</note> See above chapter 15. §. 12.</margin>

Through sacrifice and worship. True worship consists of an earnest desire, where the fire-soul takes its hunger from all

**4. Question: Why then did the first fathers sacrifice, and who commanded them to do so?**

**Answer:** The soul’s free will is as thin as a "Nothing"; and although in its body it is surrounded by the "Something," yet its captured "Something" exists in a false-seeking being, derived from the original state of sin. Now, if the free will is to move with desire toward GOD, it must first depart from its false "Something." And if it thus departs, it is naked and powerless, for it is back in the original "Nothing." Then, if it wishes to go toward GOD, it must die to the false selfhood and abandon it; and as it abandons it, it is merely as a "Nothing," and thus cannot travel, work, or weave. If it wishes to show its power, it must be within something in which it can grasp and form itself. We have an example of this in faith: if there is to be a faith that works, it must grasp itself in something wherein it may work. GOD’S free will has grasped itself with the inner spiritual world and works through it; and the inner world’s free will has grasped itself with the outer world and works through it. Likewise, the soul’s free will—which also has its origin in the <term>Ungrund</term> <note>original: "Ungrund." Böhme's term for the "groundless" or "abyssal" void that exists before all created things—the source from which God and the world emerge.</note>—must grasp itself in something so that it may be manifest and so that it may journey toward GOD.

Because Adam’s body was made from the <term>Limus</term> <note>original: "Limus." Latin for "slime" or "mud," referring to the "dust of the ground" from Genesis 2:7, which Böhme interprets as a quintessence of both earthly and heavenly substances.</note> of the earth, and also from the <term>Limus</term> of the holy

<column-break/>

heaven—but the <term>Limus</term> of heaven had faded within Adam, in which the free will could have grasped itself in a heavenly form to journey, work, pray, and plead before GOD—they therefore ignited the fruits of the earth. As Cain brought from the fruits of the field, and Abel also brought from the firstlings of his flock, they ignited these with fire.

<margin>Mysterium Magnum, Chapter 27, Paragraphs 4–7.</margin>

**5. Question: But why did the first fathers not grasp their desire of faith in heavenly and invisible things, but rather in certain animals, and their death, in fire, wood, the altar, and the like?**

**Answer:** We have proven above how the poor soul, through its false imagination and its own impression, became a hungry <term>fire-source</term> <note>original: "Feuer-Quall." A pun on the German words for "source" (Quelle) and "torment" (Qual). It describes the soul's state as a burning, agonizing hunger for God’s light.</note>, which is merely an enclosure of the true life. To this impressed soul-being—dead to GOD and blind to GOD—the great love of GOD came to help again out of pure grace as soon as the soul, along with the body, had thus fallen. GOD spoke Himself back into the center of the soul—into the impressed, closed, and faded heavenly <term>Ens</term> <note>original: "Ens." Latin for "being" or "essence." Here it refers to the spiritual substance of the "inner man" that was lost in the Fall.</note> of the soul—as into the former fountain of gentleness, which was no longer active. Into this, the moving power spoke itself again as a new Center and Covenant: that in the fullness of time, GOD would introduce and manifest His living <term>Ens</term>—the essential Word of His power and wisdom—with the highest love, as the name JESUS out of JEHOVAH, into this "in-spoken" voice of grace and into man’s faded heavenly <term>Ens</term>. Thus, He would make the faded being of the heavenly part living and green again, so that the soul might eat from it, and its anxious fire-source would thereby be transmuted and changed into a fire of love.

This "in-spoken" Word of grace concerning the Serpent-Treader <note>A reference to Genesis 3:15, the prophecy that the offspring of the woman would crush the head of the serpent.</note> is now that which the souls...

### Part 3 / Chapter 16.

...turning away from error, and leading the soul into the true living **GOD**, so that **GOD** is introduced into it. Thus, **GOD** may work within the soul according to His holy Will, and soothe the wrath and all contrary properties in nature. This is where the great work of reconciliation actually consists: not in any external thing, but solely in the earnest will directed toward **GOD’S** mercy, in prayer and petition to **GOD**, so that the human being leaves the evil will, turns around, performs repentance, and directs their faith and hope into **GOD’S** mercy.

->*Mysterium Magnum*, Chapter 27, Section 1<-

**4. Question:** Why then did the first fathers sacrifice? Who commanded them to do so?

**Answer:** The soul’s free will is as thin as a Nothing; and although in its body it is surrounded by the "Something," its perceived "Something" exists in a false, craving essence originating from sin. If the free will is to move toward **GOD** with its desire, it must first go out from its false "Something." When it goes out in this way, it is naked and powerless, for it is once again in the original "Nothing" <note>Böhme uses "Nothing" (*Nichts*) or the "Groundless" (*Ungrund*) to describe the state of pure potentiality before it takes on a specific form or desire.</note>. If it then wishes to go toward **GOD**, it must die to the false selfhood and leave it behind; and if it leaves that selfhood, it is merely a "Nothing" and cannot travel, work, or weave <note>original: "weben"; an archaic term for moving or being active</note>. If it wants to show its power, it must be within something in which it can grasp and form itself.

We have an example of this in faith: if there is to be a faith that works, it must grasp onto something in which to work. **GOD’S** free will grasped itself with the inner spiritual world and works through it; and the free will of the inner world grasped itself with the outer world and works through it. Likewise, the soul’s free will—which also has its origin in the "Groundless"—must grasp onto something so that it may be revealed, and so that it can move toward **GOD**.

Because Adam's body was made from the <term>Slime</term> <note>original: "Limo/Limus"; referring to the "dust of the ground" in Genesis, but understood here as a physical and spiritual "extract" or "matter"</note> of the earth, and also from the <term>Slime</term> of the holy 

<column-break/>

heaven, but the <term>Slime</term> of heaven had faded in Adam—within which the free will could have grasped a heavenly form to move, work, pray, and petition before **GOD**—they instead ignited the fruits of the earth. Thus Cain brought from the fruits of the field, and Abel also brought from the firstlings of his flock; these they ignited with fire.

->*Mysterium Magnum*, Chapter 27, Sections 4 and 7<-

**5. Question:** But why did the first fathers not grasp their faith-desire in heavenly and invisible things, but rather in certain animals, and their death, in fire, wood, the altar, and the like?

**Answer:** We have shown above how the poor soul, through its false <term>imagination</term> <note>The power of the soul to "image" or "form" itself into a specific state of being</note> and its own impression, became a hungry fire-torment, which is merely a confinement of the true life. To this soul-essence—which was impressed, dead to **GOD**, and blind to **GOD**—the great love of **GOD** came to help again out of pure grace as soon as the soul and body had fallen. **GOD** spoke Himself back into the center of the soul, into the impressed, closed, and faded heavenly <term>Essence</term> <note>original: "Ens"; a technical term for the fundamental "being" or "substance" of a thing</note> of the soul, which was the former source of gentleness that was no longer active. Into this, the moving power spoke itself again as a new Center and Covenant: that in the fulfillment of time, **GOD** would introduce and reveal His living <term>Essence</term>—the essential Word of His power and wisdom, with the highest love, the name **JESUS** out of **JEHOVAH**—into this spoken-in voice of grace and into man’s faded heavenly <term>Essence</term>. Thereby, He would make the faded essence of the heavenly part alive and greening again, so that the soul could eat from it, and its anxious fire-torment would be transmuted and changed into a love-fire.

This spoken-in Word of grace of the <term>Serpent-Crusher</term> <note>A traditional title for Christ, referring to the prophecy in Genesis 3:15 that the seed of the woman would crush the head of the serpent</note> is what now performs the

The souls of the holy children of **GOD** before Christ’s incarnation were ignited so that they believed in **GOD** and His promise of the future fulfillment. In this faith, they offered sacrifices. For their sacrifice—especially that of the first fathers after Adam—was nothing other than the presentation of an image: how the soul should be sacrificed in the **Wrath-fire** of **GOD**, and how, through this "in-spoken" ground of grace and covenant, the soul should be transmuted within the **Wrath-fire** of **GOD** and changed into a **Love-fire**. It showed how the soul should enter into the death and dying of its self-will along with its false impressions, and how its false willing should burn away in the **Wrath-fire**. Then, by the power of this in-spoken grace of the love and gentleness of **GOD**, it would go out through the fire into a bright light, thus becoming a newborn child that is not dark, but light. Just as smoke separates from fire and light, the poison introduced by the Serpent had to be separated from the soul, so that the fire and light would then be a clear radiance, no longer enclosed as it lies enclosed within the essence of wood.

They presented this image to themselves with the sacrifice, and directed their <term>imagination</term> <note>In Böhme's thought, "Imagination" is not mere fantasy, but a creative, soul-shaping power that "images" or forms internal reality.</note> into it with the in-spoken grace of the "Seed of the Woman" and the <term>Serpent-Crusher</term> <note>A reference to the promised Savior in Genesis 3:15.</note>. In this way, their imagination formed itself into the figure of Christ, so that their "will-spirit" stood in a formation wherein it could work within grace. For no working occurs without a substance. Thus, they imagined their rebirth with the sacrifice through the fire, and pictured the **Serpent-Crusher** within the fire—how he would change God's **Wrath-fire** in the soul’s fire into a **Light-fire** and **Love-fire**, and how the enmity would be separated from the soul. They saw how the soul, through Christ’s death—wherein the love of **GOD** gave itself into this fire—would be transformed into an angel. Through this modeled image, they pressed

<column-break/>

with their desire and earnest prayer to **GOD**. In this way, **God’s** Word of grace had also been "in-spoken" and modeled within the human being; now there was a <term>conjunction</term> <note>original: "Conjunction"; a union or joining together, often used in alchemy to describe the marriage of opposites.</note> between **GOD** and man. For the human desire entered into **GOD** through this image, and **God’s** love-desire entered into this image of the **Serpent-Crusher**. Thus, the human desire led this image of the imagination into the sacrifice: and so the sacrifice was ignited with the holy fire. <note>NB.</note> And it was not a common fire among them. If you, Babel <note>Böhme frequently uses "Babel" to refer to the confused, divided, and superficial institutional churches of his day.</note>, could understand this, it would be well for you, and you would be delivered from the fables in which you run.

This holy fire consumed their sacrifices through **God’s** imagination and ignition, to signify how the animal image of man should be tested in the fire of **GOD**, and the coarseness of the elements consumed. And from the consumption of the fire would emerge the right, true, pure, and beautiful spiritual image created in Adam, which—through this great love—was to be tested and brought through the fire into clarity. In this new image, Love itself would be the fire of life, so that it might no longer imagine or "imprint" falsehood. With such imagination and faith, the first humans before the time of Christ—before he revealed himself in this embodied **Covenant of Grace** and became man—were enclosed within the living Word of **GOD** as within grace. Therein their souls came into divine rest until the fulfillment, when Christ completed this process and rose from the dead. Thus, He also arose with His life and essence within them, in their inward ground of the heavenly part which had faded in Adam; they put on Christ according to the soul and spiritual essence. Thus, only their body from the <term>muck</term> <note>original: "Limo"; from the Latin *limus*, referring to the dust or slime of the earth from which Adam was made.</note> of the earth—as the third <term>principle</term> <note>original: "Principium"; Böhme's term for one of the three fundamental realms of reality (Darkness, Light, and the Material World).</note>, as the out-spoken, formed, essential, outer word—waits with its <term>spirit</term> <note>original: "Spiritu"</note> for the resurrection on the Last Day, as then

**6. Question:** But what similarity, nature, and property does the external sacrifice have in all of this?

**Answer:** To understand the sacrifices correctly and fundamentally / one must consider that with which one sacrifices / and what separates itself from the fire through the ignition (out of the kindled sacrifice). For in the ignition, nothing more is seen or recognized than, firstly / the wood for the fire; secondly / the <term>material</term> <note>Latin: *materia*; the physical substance of the offering.</note> of the sacrifice; thirdly / the fire and light; and fourthly / the smoke from the fire / which originates from the firewood and from the material of the sacrifice. All of this, without faith and Divine desire, is an abomination and a nothingness before **GOD** / and it does not reach the gates of **GOD**. But if man introduces his faith-desire into it / then he yields his free will into it / and intends through it—as through a medium in which fire the free will of the introduced "sin-abomination" burns away—to penetrate to **GOD** in His eternal free will. And how that then happens: Understand it thus.

**GOD's** <term>Imagination</term> <note>In Böhme's philosophy, "Imagination" is the creative power of the spirit to form reality or "image" itself into a state of being.</note> (or Desire) goes toward the free, breathed-in will of humanity / and the human free will goes toward the Godhead: There is a <term>conjunction</term> <note>A joining or meeting point between the divine and the human.</note>. But now the human free will has become sinful / and **GOD's** free will (from which the human will originally arose through His breathing-into it) is holy and pure. Now the human free will is not able to penetrate into **GOD's** will / unless it also becomes pure before **GOD's** will. However, because **GOD's** will gladly wants to take it into Himself for His "Love-play" / there is no other counsel than that **GOD** moves Himself in the <term>center</term> <note>Latin: *centro*; the inward source or core.</note> of eternal nature according to the fire of the second <term>Principle</term> <note>Latin: *principii*; Böhme describes reality as having three "Principles": the dark fire-world, the light-world, and the outer world.</note> (as according to the holy fire) / and swallows up the ignited wrath and vanity of man's free will;

and in the dying of death / (as in the **Wrath-fire** of **GOD** /) makes it into nothing / so that the human will may become pure before **GOD's** will / and may enter into **GOD's** Love-will. And for that reason, **GOD's** Love-desire kindled the sacrifice in Abel and Moses / so that the Love and holy fire (within the **Wrath-fire** of eternal nature in the Father's property / in the human free soul-will) would swallow the <term>Turba</term> <note>A Latin term Böhme uses to describe the "turmoil" or "disturber"—the destructive element of God's wrath that breaks things apart.</note>. For the *limus* of the earth shall rise again from death / but if it were to become a sacrifice / it also had to be sacrificed in an earthly elemental fire of its own likeness / so that thus a heavenly fire and an earthly elemental fire would be within one another / and each will in the sacrifice would find a place for its own self-inclusion / namely the will from the earthly *limus* of the earth from the kingdom of this world / and the heavenly will from the heavenly *limus*, as from the <term>essence of the Word of the Lord</term> <note>Latin: *ento* (essence) *Verbi Domini* (of the Word of the Lord).</note>. Each property of the free will went into the sacrifice / and out of the sacrifice into the fire / where the reconciliation was. # Of Cain and Abel.

Thus also the words of the prayer of Abel and Israel <note>Böhme uses "Israel" here not just as a national name, but as a spiritual designation for the "children of light" who exist within the covenant even before the historical nation of Israel.</note> formed and took shape in the sacrifice into substance, as into an unbreakable being/ in which being Christ, God’s Son/ in the fullness of time/ broke forth from the covenant/ and took that same being upon himself alongside the human being/ and as a hero and knight shattered the kingdom of death and the devil. And to that same faith-being/ in the spirit of **CHRIST** in all his children and members/ was given the judgment over the world/ also over the devil’s and death’s kingdom/ to destroy the same works therewith/ and to possess the Royal Throne.

This was the true sacrifice of Abel/ for the spirit of the holy love-fire in the goal of the covenant had opened itself in him, so that he understood this: And therefore he sacrificed/ so that his faith-desire should be accepted before **GOD**/ and brought into a substance for the new re-birth/ for he looked upon the promise of the **serpent-crusher** <note>original: "Schlangen-Treter." This refers to the prophecy in Genesis 3:15 that the seed of the woman would crush the head of the serpent, interpreted by Böhme as the first promise of the coming Christ.</note>/ and led his faith-desire into him; and willed/ that his faith-spirit and life should be confirmed in the promised serpent-crusher: He wanted to be acceptable before **GOD** therein/ as indeed happened to him/ that the fire of **GOD** ignited his sacrifice/ and took in his prayer in the love-fire/ and in the sweet smell of the sacrifice through the Spirit of **GOD**/ in the power of the light was brought into a holy substance/ that was rightly called: His sacrifice was acceptable before **GOD**.

The sacrifice alone would not have been able to do it/ only faith/ which in the sacrifice took hold of the promised **Messiah**, who seized the covenant and the true, highly-precious sacrifice/ that did it: The sacrifice was only a figure of that which was performed therein/ just as the outer world is only a figure of the inner spiritual world/ so that the spiritual world introduces itself into a figure and being/ and gazes as if in a mirror.

->to sacrifice, what did he<-
->sacrifice?<-

Answer. Cain was the first-born according to the flesh, and because the quality of the dark world had the upper hand in Adam and Eve, the serpent-essence <note>original: "Schlangen Ens." In Böhme's theosophy, "Ens" refers to the essential spiritual seed or "being" that inhabits a creature. Here, it refers to the corrupted nature inherited from the Fall.</note>, as the false fire-desire of the soul, had also propagated into their children, and taken hold in Cain. Now as Cain, the first-born according to the flesh, was held by Eve to be the man, the Lord <note>A reference to Eve's exclamation in Genesis 4:1, "I have gotten a man from the Lord," which Böhme interprets as Eve mistakenly thinking Cain was the promised Savior.</note>, so he relied on fleshly privilege/ and sacrificed in his own righteousness/ and in his sacrifice sought only the power of the outer world and earthly pleasure/ and wanted to be a son or child accepted from the outside before **GOD**/ **GOD** should let his evil beast <note>Referring to the fallen, animalistic nature of the "outer man."</note> be acceptable and sacrificed to Him/ he wanted with his selfhood in the serpent-essence and falsehood to be **GOD’S** acceptable child/ he was an unrepentant, proud man/ who thought to become a lord of the world/ and to rule over Abel and his descendants. It was not his concern that he wanted to be or become a new creature/ but **GOD** should thus accept his sin in the sacrifice/ he wanted to remain the old Cain/ and thus sacrifice to **GOD**/ that he might be acceptable before him/ the devil came before **GOD** in the form of an angel. Cain did not recognize his evil, serpentine quality/ the poor soul was captured by it/ and had swung itself upward in the serpent-essence, wit, and pride/ he wanted to be a child and heir of **GOD** accepted from the outside/ the sacrifice was supposed to reconcile him.

Cain seized the Kingdom of Wrath / as the first Principle in his essence in the seed in the mother's womb during the struggle / and Abel seized **GOD’S** Love / as the second Principle; thus Cain was by nature evil / and Abel was pious.

When Cain and Abel offered their sacrifices / then **GOD** / that is / **GOD’S** Love and Meekness / as the second Principle / smelled the sacrifice of Abel / but **GOD** would not accept Cain’s. There you see the struggle between the two eternal Principles / between Love and Wrath / in the two brothers / in man / how the dark, fierce kingdom was also made manifest in man. Thus **GOD** spoke to Cain; why are you enraged? Is it not so / if you are pious / then you are acceptable / but if not / then sin rests before the door : But rule over it / and do not give it the power.

Now **Abel**, your servant / he has entered into this world as a guest. But he stands and bears [himself] out of this world back into his Fatherland: You cannot tolerate him / you press him to the ground in two ways / all quite cunningly and by your own power. Firstly, with your hypocritical false doctrine at **Babel** <note>Böhme uses "Babel" to represent the confused, divided, and spiritually dead institutional churches of his time.</note> / in which he shall and must believe what you prescribe for him without God's Spirit / whereby you only strengthen your bloated "Fat-Kingdom" <note>An image of worldly prosperity and spiritual stagnation.</note> / by which you draw him onto a path away from **GOD** into the spirit of this world / so that he must look upon your idle chatter / and if he does not do so / then you murder him as you did **Abel**. Secondly / you have set yourself as lord over him / and have made him your serf / and thus you parade over him / like the proud woman of this world <note>A reference to the Whore of Babylon from the Book of Revelation.</note>. You torment him day and night / and consume his sweat in pride / all according to the vengeance of the wrath. Thus he sits not only in darkness / but in great sorrow and misery / and seeks a way of escape / how he might yet come into the light / and flee the driver. But he finds in your gates nothing but the way of falsehood / with high-finance <note>original: "Finantz" — in the 17th century, this term specifically implied deceit, trickery, or usury in business.</note>, cunning / lies / deceit / and also greed / and trying to wind himself out / so that he may only live under your yoke. And thus he murders his own poor soul / even himself under your yoke / and so separates himself from the Kingdom of **GOD** / and gives himself into the spirit of this world / kneels and prays before your **beast** / and honors your proud **bride** / who rides upon your **beast** / as the Spirit of **GOD** shows us in the **Revelation of JESUS Christ**. Thus you constantly murder poor **Abel** in two ways / and give him great offense with your power and splendor / drawing him from **GOD** into the spirit of this world / where he then becomes stone-blind / and wants to ride after you forever / he always wants to sit upon your beast / and also be a lord / and ride over bowed knees / and so the kingdom of this world is a true murderous pit / and before **GOD** a pit of shame. ### Of Cain and Abel.

[The spirit of this world] makes him into ashes and earth / and takes your goods / as well as power and splendor / and gives them to another / and torments him also for a time therein. And then, secondly / it captures all your deeds and intentions / and places them into the <term>Tincture</term> <note>In Böhme’s writing, the "Tincture" refers to the subtle, spiritual essence or "inner quality" that colors and shapes the soul’s reality.</note> of your soul / and makes another dwelling-house out of them for your soul / so that it does not send the soul away naked. And then, thirdly / that it has led your soul out of Heaven into the lusts of this world: Thus it now leaves the soul sitting in its misery, entirely naked and well-befouled / and it drives away / and asks nothing further / where the soul is / or how it fares / even if it remains in the abyss of hell: This is what you have to expect from the spirit of this world as your reward / for having served it so faithfully.

Therefore / O Cain! flee from the spirit of this world; there is a fire within it from the LORD from Heaven, out of the root of the original source; your bloated and secret kingdom shall be set ablaze, so that you may be seen in all places; you shall stand completely open, with all your secrets: For the spirit of the great world has found the <term>Tincture</term>, and blooms upon its roses in the wonder.

10. **Question:** But how may I distinguish the false Anti-Christian and Cainish Church from the true Abelian Church?

**Answer:** The Cainish Church parades about / and glitters on all sides with magnificent ceremonies / letting itself be proclaimed / as holy / righteous and good / it also offers sacrifices within the covenant of Christ / but its heart is only a glittering, well-adorned whore / full of Cainish murderous blasphemy / of self-contemplation in pride / in greed and arrogance; but the Abelian Church is hidden beneath it / in great simplicity / with no outward reputation / and is regarded as only foolish compared to the splendor of Cain / and is forever being murdered in its simplicity by Cain.

## Of Cain and Abel.

There arose a great enmity against the fury of eternal nature / according to the dark property / for the human essence had become half a devil according to the dark world’s property in the soul / and half a beast according to the outward world’s vanity / in which beast the false-cunning / evil / greedy / proud / avaricious / envious and angry serpent-worm sat, infected by the devil’s will.

This grim / malicious / monstrous beast wanted to live in its own self-centered property; thus there appeared against it in Abel the <term>Virgin-Child</term> <note>original: "jungfrauen-Kind." In Böhme's thought, this refers to the "new man" or the spiritual birth within the soul that restores the pure, "virginal" image of God lost at the Fall.</note> / who was to destroy and rule over the kingdom of this evil beast / that was a great enmity. For the wrath of GOD had captured man / and wanted to work and rule in him / so GOD’s love broke forth out of the wrath / like a light out of a fire / and wanted to kill the wrath and transform it into love / and help the poor image of man again / and redeem it from eternal wrath and death. But because the wrath had gained the governance in man / and the Virgin-Child was to <term>green</term> <note>original: "durchgrünen." A favorite metaphor of Böhme, suggesting life, growth, and the flourishing of spring breaking through the cold of winter or the heat of fire.</note> through the wrath from the essence of the angelic world out of the covenant of GOD / out of the faded <term>essence</term> <note>original: "Ente," likely a variation of "Ens" or essence, or referring to a spiritual graft.</note> / just as a bright light shines through a grim fire from a candle / which takes away the power of the darkness / so the outer body in the children of GOD had to let itself be killed and persecuted by the wrath of GOD / for it was a foreign figure upon the Virgin-Child. For Abel likewise had the awakened vanity lying within his outward flesh / just as Cain did: According to the outer man, he was also sinful / but in the inner man, the angelic world and the Paradise-image flourished again in the covenant / that was now a great enmity against one another; the inner man trod upon the head of the serpent-monster’s false desire / so the serpent-monster stung him in the heel of his angelic will / and mocked the angelic image / as it still

Because the Virgin-Child works through the outer man / like a light through fire / and reveals itself; it teaches and rebukes the godless crowd / which the devil cannot endure / for it is against his kingdom / just as Abel's sacrifice was against Cain's. For Cain sacrificed in proud serpent-desire as a <term>hypocrite</term> <note>original: "Gleißner," literally one who glistens or shines outwardly but is hollow or false within.</note> / and wanted to be a pious child pleasing to GOD in his serpent-desire: But Abel humbled himself before GOD / and went with his desire into GOD’S mercy: GOD’S fire of love accepted his sacrifice / and pressed through the earthly sacrifice and fire: This is also to be understood in the body of Abel / just as the incorruptible shall swallow up the corruptible / so also the heavenly took the earthly captive into itself. But that Cain murdered the outer body of Abel / that is the image / that the outer body shall be put to death in the wrath of GOD: The wrath must swallow and kill the outer image / which grew in the wrath / and out of death the great eternal life greens forth.

We should proceed further here, and demonstrate according to all circumstances, how from Adam onward in all the Fathers until Christ it was tested, whether it were possible, that man might become free from earthliness through his own fire-power, and enter again into Paradise, and reach again the light of GOD in gentleness, and how far the word of promise in its power and impulse sprouted forth in the Fathers, such as Enoch, Noah, Abraham, Isaac, Jacob and their children. In particular, how GOD moved in the Father's property, and awakened Moses, and tested through Moses, whether He might carry out the work of redemption through Moses, and restore the people of Israel into Paradise, as into the promised land, whether the people could live in trust in GOD, die to <term>selfhood</term> <note>original: "Selbstheit." # Concerning the Incarnation of JESUS Christ.

...of the Holy Trinity has moved in the seed of the woman. For God’s heart did not wish to reveal itself in the fire, as in the man’s <term>tincture</term> <note>original: "Tinctur." In theosophical writing, a tincture is a spiritual essence or "color" that gives life its specific quality; the "man's tincture" is associated with fire and strength, while the "woman's" is associated with light and water.</note>, but rather in the tincture of the Spirit, as in that of Venus <note>original: "Veneris." Referring here to the planetary/alchemical principle of love and gentleness rather than the Roman goddess.</note>, in the love of life; so that the fire in the man's tincture might be seized by the gentleness and love of God. For out of the enclosed death, eternal life should and must sprout forth again. For here the root of Jesse and the true rod of Aaron have blossomed and brought forth beautiful fruits: For in Adam, Paradise was locked in death when he became earthly; but in Christ, it sprouted again out of death.

From Adam we have all inherited death; from Christ we inherit eternal life. Christ is the virginal image that Adam was meant to bring forth from himself, possessing both tinctures; but because he could not, he was divided and had to give birth through two bodies until <term>Shiloh</term> <note>original: "Siloh." A messianic title from Genesis 49:10, traditionally interpreted as "he to whom it belongs" or "the bringer of peace."</note> came—that is, the Son of the Virgin, who was born of God and man. He is the "Breaker-through" of whom the prophets spoke, who shoots up like a twig; he blossoms like a laurel tree in God’s essence. By his entrance into the human, half-dead essence, he broke death, for he blossomed simultaneously in human and also in divine essence. He brought into our humanity the virginal discipline of God’s wisdom; he surrounded our soul-essence with heavenly substance. He became the hero in the battle when the two kingdoms were at war with each other—namely, God’s wrath and love. He gave himself willingly into the wrath and extinguished it with his love—understand this as happening within the human essence. He came from God into this world and took our soul into himself, so that he might lead us out of the earthliness of this world back into himself, into God. He birthed us anew in himself, so that we might be fit to live in God once more. From his will he birthed us, so that we should place our will into him; thus he led us in himself back to the Father, into our first fatherland—into the Paradise from which Adam departed. He has become our wellspring; his water wells up within us. He is the fountain, and we are his drops within him. He has become the fullness of our being, so that we live in God through him. For God became man: He introduced his unfathomable and immeasurable essence into humanity. His essence, which fills the heavens, he revealed in humanity. Thus human essence and God’s essence have become one essence, a fullness of God. Our being is his movement in his heaven: We are his children, his wonder, his movement in his unfathomable body. He is the Father, and we are children in him. We dwell in him, and he in us. We are his instrument, with which he seeks and performs what he wills. He is the fire and also the light in all being: He is hidden, and the work makes him manifest.

From this, so much bickering and strife has arisen concerning his person, because external reason always presumed to fathom what GOD and man are, and how GOD and man can be one person. Because this is a near and intimate work for the children of GOD—one they should engage with daily and hourly, constantly entering into the Incarnation of Christ and departing from earthly reason—they must be born in this miserable life within the birth and Incarnation of Christ, if they wish to be GOD'S children in Christ.

Therefore, I have resolved to write down this high mystery according to my understanding and gift as a memorial, so that I may have cause to heartily delight and refresh myself with my Immanuel <note>Hebrew: "God with us."</note>, since I also stand within this birth alongside other children of Christ. I do this so that I might have a monument and a source of encouragement, should the dark and earthly flesh and blood—coated with the devil's poison—seek to overwhelm me and darken my noble image. I have undertaken this as an exercise of faith, so that my soul, like a little branch on its tree, JESUS Christ, may refresh itself with His sap and power. I do this not with clever and high-minded speeches of art or from the reason of this world, but according to the knowledge I have from my tree, Christ, so that my little branch may also turn green and grow alongside others in the tree and life of GOD.    If we now reflect within our own reason and look upon that which the world at Babel has introduced in this article of faith—which we intend to treat here—considering our high knowledge, and how the Anti-Christ <note>To the author, the "Anti-Christ" represents the spirit of self-interest and false doctrine ruling within the visible church.</note> has established himself and displayed his great power therein, our reason might well be inclined to hold us back because of the great danger of the Anti-Christ’s wrath, which might befall us. 3. Question: Who then became man?
   Answer: The true natural Son of GOD, GOD in GOD, in the Father of eternity, born from the Father of eternity from eternity, without beginning and end, out of the depth of omnipotence, out of the burst-open gates of the <term>Sharpness of God</term> <note>The "Sharpness" or "Severity" (Schärffe) refers to the first principle of God's nature—His fiery, creative energy before it is tempered by Light.</note> into the Delight, where the Father begets the lovely Delight in His eternal will, with which the will is eternally pregnant. This is the drawn-in power of the Light, from which the Father conceives the second will, the power to bring forth; and this conceiving is His Word, which the Father speaks out of the will, before the will, and the speaking remains in the Father’s mouth as a conceived Word with the other will. And the proceeding from the spoken Word, which goes out from the will through the Word, is the Spirit of the mouth of GOD, the Holy Spirit; and that which is spoken before the will is the eternal Wisdom of GOD, the Virgin of Purity <note>The "Virgin of Wisdom" or "Sophia" is a central figure in this philosophy, representing the divine mirror or blueprint of all things.</note>. For GOD begets only His Heart and Son, and desires to beget nothing else out of Himself; therefore, that which is spoken before the will is a Virgin of Purity, who also begets nothing more, but beholds herself in the Holy Spirit, in the infinite—in the deep wonders of omnipotence—and opens them. And she has the mighty <term>Fiat</term> <note>Latin: "Let it be done." The creative command of God.</note> of GOD as her instrument, with which she creates everything, and in the beginning did create; and she beholds herself in all created things, so that the wonders of all things are brought to light through her.

# Of the Incarnation of JESUS Christ.

GOD spoke to Adam and Eve in Paradise concerning the **Serpent-Treader** <note>original: "Schlangen-Treter." This refers to the promised Messiah (Christ) who, according to Genesis 3:15, would crush the head of the serpent.</note> / who had formed himself into the gates of the Light of Life / standing within the center of the Heavenly Gate / and perceptibly waiting within the soul of the holy human / until this time / that the same Word became human / and the Divine Word entered again into the **Virgin of Divine Wisdom** <note>The "Virgin of Wisdom" (Sophia) is a central figure in this mystical tradition, representing the mirror of God and the pure, spiritual essence that humanity lost at the Fall.</note> / which was given to Adam's soul. This soul / when it was surrounded with the pure elemental and Paradisiacal body / separated its will from the Father's will (which only aims to grasp its own power / with which it is pregnant / to bring forth its Heart) / and the soul entered into the lust of this world / where now / behind it / there is no light in the breaking of the world / and before it / there is no graspability of the Godhead. And there was no counsel / unless the pure will of GOD the Father entered into it again / and led it back into its first seat in His own will / so that its will might again be directed into the Heart and Light of GOD. If it was to be helped / then the Heart of GOD with its light / and not the Father / had to come into it. For it stands in the Father regardless / but turned away from the entrance to the birth of the Heart of GOD / back into this world / where no light may be grasped either behind or before / for when the essence of the body breaks / the poor soul stands imprisoned in the dark dungeon. And here the love of GOD toward the poor imprisoned soul is recognized. Reflect upon this / O precious mind!

Here now there was no counsel / neither in GOD nor in any creature / except that the bare Deity of the Heart of GOD should enter into the **Holy Ternary** <note>original: "Ternarium Sanctum." In this mystical context, it refers to the "Holy Third" state—the manifested divine realm or the "holy earth" where spiritual substance exists.</note> / understand / into the Mercy / which is born from His Holiness from eternity / wherein the Eternal Wisdom / which [comes] from the speaking of the Word through the Holy Spirit / stands as a Virgin before the Deity / and is the great wonder / and is a spirit in

the Mercy / and the Mercy makes the **Holy Ternary**, the holy earth: the Father's essences / in drawing toward the Word / are the holy constellation / to be compared thus. Just as we think that in this world there is fire / air / water / and earth / and then the sun and stars / and within them are all beings of this world. So think in a likeness / that the Father is the fire of the whole constellation / and also in the element; and the Son / His Heart / is the Sun / who sets the whole constellation into a bright / sweet delight / and the Holy Spirit is the Air of life / without which no sun or constellation could exist; and the gathered spirit / **of the Greater World** <note>original: "Majoris Mundi," referring to the Macrocosm or the universe as a whole.</note> / is the modest Virgin before GOD / which spirit / **of the Greater World**, gives mind / sense / and understanding to all creatures in this world / through the influence of the stars / so also in heaven. The earthly earth is compared to the **Holy Ternary**, wherein is the heavenly **Aquaster** <note>A term from spiritual alchemy referring to a "spiritual-watery" substance or heavenly ether.</note> / understand / in the heavenly earth / which I call the Element / which is pure. Thus GOD is a Spirit / and the pure element is heavenly earth / for it is substantial / and the essences in the heavenly earth are the Paradise of growth / and the Virgin of Wisdom is the great spirit of the entire heavenly world / to be compared thus / and she opens the great wonders not only in the heavenly earth / but also in the entire depth of the Deity. For the Deity is incomprehensible and invisible / yet perceptible: But the Virgin is visible / as a pure spirit / and the Element is her body / that is called the **Holy Ternary**, the holy earth. **5. Question: Did the Word then not assume our earthly humanity?**

**Answer:** The Word became a heavenly Paradisiacal human, in the highest Virginly holiness and perfection; and this Paradisiacal human was within the earthly assumed humanity like day is in the night, until the time of his transfiguration and revelation. For our earthly, animalistic humanity was and is not the true **Image of GOD** <note>original: "Bildnus GOTTES."</note> which God created and in which God dwells; rather, this earthly human is formed by the spirit of this world, as we mentioned above. His animalistic soul is a **source-tension** <note>original: "Quall." A technical term for Böhme meaning both "source" (Quelle) and "torment" (Qual), referring to the energetic friction of the elemental forces.</note> and ignition of the stars and elements; his stinking corpse is a brood of the spirit of this world and a miserable, wretched prison of the soul. Thus, the true humanity of the body and soul is corrupted, and we no longer possess the pure element as a body, but rather the "offshoot"—namely, the four elements under the dominion of the stars. The sun is now merely the light of the body, and this body does not belong in the Godhead. GOD does not reveal Himself in the stinking corpse, but in the holy human, in the pure image which He created in the beginning. Thus, since man had fallen from the Holy into the Unholy, from the Image of GOD into the earthly fragile state, his body was within fragile death and his soul stood within the eternal will of the Father, yet turned away from the Heart of GOD into the spirit of this world, seized by eternal darkness. For whatever goes out from GOD goes into darkness, and outside the Heart of GOD there is no light. Now, there was no remedy for this image unless it were born anew through the soul, through the Heart and Light of GOD, through which the new element before GOD—as the soul’s body—would be reborn; otherwise, the Godhead could not and would not dwell therein. Yet man was not able to achieve this by his own powers; if it were to 

<column-break/>

happen, then the Mercy of GOD had to do it. And let the God-loving reader be clearly instructed here in this great depth as to where the pure element is, in which our body stood before the Fall of Adam, and in which it now stands in the new rebirth. It is the heavenly corporeality, which is not merely a spirit in which the clear Godhead dwells; it is not the pure Godhead itself, but is born from the essences of the holy Father. However, through the eternal gates in the eternal mind within itself, through the re-captured will, it enters always and eternally into eternal joy, where it brings forth its eternal Word. Thus the pure element is the **womb** <note>original: "Barm." Böhme derives "Barmherzigkeit" (mercy) from "Barm" (womb/lap) and "Herz" (heart), implying a maternal, creative matrix within the divine.</note> in the essences of the drawing toward the Word; the essences are Paradise, and the womb is the Element. Now, as the Father always speaks the eternal Word, the Holy Spirit goes forth from that speaking, and that which is spoken is the Eternal Wisdom; she is a Virgin, and the pure element, as the womb, is her body. Within this, the Holy Spirit beholds Himself through the spoken Wisdom; thus the "glance" out of the light of GOD in the Holy Spirit is called the "Heart." Then the element begins in the essences of Paradise to become substantial; then it is called **Jesus** <note>Abbreviated in original as "Jg." likely for "Jesus" or "Jungling" (youth/blossom).</note>. And the Father’s strong and great fire-power goes like a flash through the essences—that is called "Time"—like a power that penetrates and does not divide the essence, like a sound. And this together is called **Mercy** <note>original: "Barmherzigkeit."</note>, and it stands before GOD, and God the Holy Trinity dwells within it. And the Virgin of the Wisdom of GOD, whom GOD the Father speaks forth through the Word, is the Spirit of the pure element; she is called a Virgin because she is so chaste and brings forth nothing; rather, like the flaming spirit in the human body, she brings forth nothing but reveals all secrets, and the body also brings forth there. The Wisdom or eternal Virgin of GOD reveals all the great wonders in the holy element. For there

...are the essences in which the plants of Paradise spring up. And if we now take the eternal bond, in which the Godhead births itself from eternity, then it is called the eternal **Limbus of GOD** <note>original: "Limbus GOttes." In Jacob Böhme’s theology, the Limbus is the "divine extraction" or the spiritual "soil" of the heavenly world from which all holy beings are formed.</note>, wherein stand the beings of all beings. For in the root of the Limbus, in the dark **anguish** <note>original: "Aengstlichkeit." A technical term describing the state of tension or "contraction" in the first properties of nature before they are illuminated by divine light.</note>, is the wrath and darkness, and the first cause of the essences. Since we have previously spoken of this at length, we will let it stand here, for we would not wish to be misunderstood, and thus we reach for our Emmanuel.

Therefore, my dear reader! know that from this glory our father Adam departed into the outgrowth of this world’s being. If he were now to be helped, Mercy had to give him new birth again, as mentioned before; and man has been provided for in this Mercy of GOD, to live therein eternally, before the foundation of the world was laid. For according to his soul, he is from the eternal will of God the Father, from which this Mercy is born.

### The Gate of Emmanuel.

Therefore, dear Christian mind! know how you have been helped, and contemplate this gate diligently; it is earnest. For Moses and all the prophets testify of these things, as of our salvation and **restoration** <note>original: "Wiederbringung." This refers to the "restitution of all things," Böhme’s belief in the eventual return of the soul to its original divine state.</note>. Do not be sleepy here in your reading; it is the most beautiful gate of this book—the more you read it, the more you will love it. If we then know that we have lost our heavenly humanity in our first fall, we also know that in God’s mercy a new one has been born for us, into which we should and must enter if we wish to be children of God; and outside of this, we are children of God's wrath. And as the prophets write of it, the new human born to us from GOD is the Son of the Virgin, not from earthly flesh and blood, nor from

<column-break/>

man’s seed, but conceived of the Holy Spirit, and born of a pure Divine, modest Virgin, and revealed in this world in our flesh and blood; and he went into death with his holy body, and has separated the earthly from the **holy element** <note>original: "heiligen Element." Böhme distinguishes the "One Element" of heaven from the four conflicting elements of our fallen world.</note> by the power of the wrath, and brought the soul back in, and opened the gate to the Light of GOD again, so that the departed soul can again reach the Light of GOD with the Father’s essences in the holy will. Thus we now recognize that we were not created to give birth in an earthly way, but in a heavenly way, out of the body of the pure element, which Adam had before his sleep and before his Eve, when he was neither man nor woman, but solely an image of GOD, full of **purity** <note>original: "Zucht." This implies a state of holy discipline, modesty, and spiritual order.</note> from the pure element, who was to give birth to an image of his own kind. But because he entered into the spirit of this world, his body became earthly: thus the heavenly birth was gone, and God had to make the woman from him, as reported before.

If we poor children of Eve were now to be helped, another Virgin had to come and bear us a son, who would be "God with us" and "God in us." And at the hour of the Fall, the Word of God the Father—and in the Word, the Light through the Holy Spirit—entered into the holy element, into the modest **Virgin of the Wisdom of GOD** <note>original: "Jungfrau der Weißheit GOttes." This is "Sophia," the eternal mirror of God's wisdom and the spiritual "womb" of the heavenly humanity.</note>, and made a precious covenant to become a creature in this Virgin, and to take the Devil’s power in the wrath, and to destroy his kingdom; and this Christ wished to involve himself in corrupted humanity, and with his entry into death, to separate the hell of wrath and the kingdom of this world from us. And God the Father revealed this Word immediately in the Garden of Eden after the Fall, concerning the promised Seed of the Woman, where it immediately gave itself into eternal marriage in the **Center of the Light of Life** <note>original: "Centrum des Lebens-Lichts."</note>, and into all human souls, which...

As we now reflect upon his precious **Incarnation** <note>original: "Menschwerdung" (Becoming-human).</note>, we must truly open the eyes of the spirit and not be so earthly-minded, as is currently the case in **Babel** <note>Böhme uses "Babel" to symbolize the confusion of worldly scholarship and institutional churches that lack spiritual understanding.</note>. We must rightly contemplate how GOD became Man; for the Scripture says: He was conceived without sin and born of a pure Virgin. Here, dear heart, consider what kind of Virgin that was. For everything born of the flesh and blood of this world is unclean, and no pure Virgin can be born in this corrupted flesh and blood. Adam's Fall breaks everything, and everything is under sin, and no pure Virgin is born from the seed of man; and yet this Christ was conceived and born of a pure Virgin without sin. Here the scholar of the school of this world must stop, and the student born of GOD must begin to teach of this birth. For the spirit of this world understands nothing further here; it is foolishness to him, and even if he travels far, he remains in Babel, within his own reason. Thus we state, according to our realization, that the pure, modest Virgin in whom GOD was born is the pure, modest Virgin before GOD, and is an **eternal Virgin**. in her Incarnation, and became her humanity in the holy element of GOD; therefore she is blessed among all women, and the LORD was with her, as the angel says.

Since it is then recognizable to us that GOD is All in All, and fulfills everything (as it is written: Am I not he who fulfills all?), we know that the pure holy element in Paradise is His dwelling; that is the second **Principle** <term>Principle: (Latin: *Principium*) One of the three fundamental realms of reality in Böhme's thought—the dark fire-world (1st), the light-world (2nd), and the outer material world (3rd).</term>. This same principle stands in all things, yet the thing—being a dead, dark outgrowth—knows it not, just as the pot knows not its potter; nor does the thing grasp or seize it. For if I lift something up, or seize it, I cannot say that I seize the holy pure element with the Godhead; rather, I seize the outgrowth, the kingdom of this world as the third Principle and its essence, and I do not move the Godhead thereby. Thus we are to recognize the holy pure man hidden within the Old [man], yet not separated until temporal death.

### 6. Question: How then did the Word, as the Son of GOD, become a heavenly Paradisiacal Man in the heavenly Virgin?

**Answer:** The will of the Heart of GOD in the Father entered from the Heart into the will of Wisdom before the Father in eternal marriage; and this same Virgin of the Wisdom of GOD in the Word of GOD gave itself into the Virgin Mary’s womb, into her virginal **Matrix** <term>Matrix: (Latin) A source, womb, or "mother-substance" from which specific forms of life or matter are birthed.</term>, and wedded itself specifically and unyieldingly for eternity—understand this as entering into the essences and into the **Tincture** <term>Tincture: A spiritual life-force or "coloring" that gives quality and vitality to matter; the highest form of spiritual medicine.</term> of the element, which is pure and undefiled before GOD. Therein the Heart of GOD became an Angelic Man, as Adam was at the Creation. # On the Incarnation of JESUS Christ.

...know that this high Angelic <note>original: "Englische." Böhme uses this term to mean "angel-like" or "pertaining to angels," referring to the perfected spiritual state of humanity.</note> image is greater than Adam, or any angel. For it is the blessing and power of all things, which is eternal in the Father. For the Word, with its entry into the element <note>The "pure element" is Böhme’s term for the spiritual substance of heaven, distinct from the four material elements.</note> into the Virgin Matrix <note>The "matrix" refers to the creative womb or the generative principle of the soul.</note>, was not separated from the Father; rather, it remains eternally in the Father, and is present at all ends in the heaven of the element into which it entered. Thus, it became a new creature in man, which is called GOD. And you should understand this very deeply and sharply: that this new creature in the holy element is not born of the Virgin's flesh and blood, but of GOD from the element, in the full abundance and union of the Holy Trinity, which remains therein eternally with full abundance without wavering. This fulfills everything everywhere in all the thrones of holiness, whose depth has no bottom, and is without number and name. Yet you should know that the physicality of the element of this creature is beneath the Godhead. For the Godhead is Spirit, and the Holy Element is born from the Word from eternity. Thus the Lord entered into the servant, which all the angels in heaven wonder at; it is the greatest wonder that has happened from eternity, for it is against nature, and that may well be called Love! And after this high-princely Angelic creature was instantly formed in the Word and Holy Spirit in the holy element—as a self-standing creature with full life and light in the Word—it also, in the same moment, took on the four elements, with the sun’s starry-regiment in the Tincture <note>A "Tincture" in Böhme’s thought is a spiritualizing essence or "color" that gives life and quality to matter.</note> of the blood, together with the blood in all human essences that were in the Virgin Mary’s body, in her matrix according to GOD’S counsel, into the element of the creature. Virgin of Divine Wisdom <note>Sophia, the personified wisdom of God.</note>, was the Master-Builder, the shaper and first beginner; and every "regiment" <note>A "regiment" refers to a governing force or system, such as the stars or the elements.</note> built its own within its center there. The Holy Spirit of GOD built the formation in the Wisdom of the Virgin in the element, in its center of heaven: the most precious, princely, and Angelic formation. And the regiment of the stars and elements of this world formed the outer man entirely with all the essences of our human bodies—with a natural body and soul—entirely like us in one person. And yet each form has its own highness, sight, suffering, and sensation; and the Divine did not mix itself in such a way that it became smaller, but remained what it was, and became what it was not, without any separation of the Divine Being. And the Word remained in the Father, and the creature of the Holy Element remained before the Father (that is, before GOD was revealed as Father in man).

It introduced living, Divine, heavenly essence into the humanity of the heavenly part that had faded in Adam (that part of him which died in Paradise). This was introduced into the seed of Mary: understand this as being in the **Tincture** of love, as into the property in which Adam was supposed to propagate in a magical, heavenly way—into the true woman's seed of the heavenly essence which had faded in Paradise. ### Part 4 / Chapter 1.

This is the goal toward which we should run: toward **Rebirth** <note>original: "Wieder-Geburt." In Böhme's thought, this is the spiritual process of restoring the soul to its original divine state.</note>. This is a greater wonder than in the first **Adam**, for the first **Adam** was created from three **Principles**, and his spirit was led in with **God's** Spirit; the Heart of **God** did not need to move itself particularly, for only **God's** Spirit moved out of **God's** Heart. But now, the **Center** or Heart of **God** moved—which had rested from eternity—and the Divine Fire was struck and ignited or awakened, however one might put it.

Thus we should rightly understand the **Incarnation** <note>original: "Menschwerdung," literally "becoming-human."</note> of **Christ**, the Son of **God**. He did not only become human in the Virgin *Mary* so that His Godhead or Divine Essence sat or was stuck imprisoned there: No, human, it has another form; do not let reason fool you, we recognize something else. Just as **God** does not dwell in one place alone, but is the fullness of all things, so too **God** did not move in only one small piece; for **God** is not divisible, but entirely present everywhere. Where He reveals Himself, there He is fully manifest; likewise, He is not measurable, and no place is found for Him unless He makes a place for Himself in a **Creature** <note>original: "Creatur," meaning any created being (human, angel, etc.).</note>; yet He is entirely alongside the creature and outside the creature. When the Word moved to the opening of Life, it opened itself in the Divine Essence as in the water of eternal life; it entered in and became **Sulphur** <term>In alchemy and Böhme's philosophy, "Sulphur" represents the formative, physical substance or "flesh" of a thing.</term>, that is, flesh and blood; it created a heavenly **Tincture** <term>A "Tincture" is a spiritual essence or medicinal quality that can transform and perfect base matter.</term>, which encompasses and fills the Godhead, within which the Wisdom of **God** stands eternally with the Divine **Magia** <note>original: "Magia." Not magic in the modern sense, but the divine creative power that brings spirit into form.</note>. Understand it rightly: The Godhead longed to become flesh and blood, and although the pure, clear Godhead remains Spirit, it has nonetheless become the Spirit and Life of the flesh, and works within the flesh, so that we can say—when we enter into **God** with our **Imagination** and surrender ourselves entirely to it—we enter into **God's** flesh and blood and live

<column-break/>

in **God**; for the Word became human, and **God** is the Word. We do not thereby abolish **Christ’s** status as a creature, as if He were not a created being. We give you a comparison with the sun and its shine, and posit it thus: We compare the sun to the creaturely body of **Christ** in this analogy—it is indeed a *Corpus* <note>original: "Corpus," Latin for "body."</note>—and we compare the entire depth of the world to the eternal Word in the Father. Now we see that the sun shines in the whole depth and gives it warmth and power: But we cannot say that in the depth, outside the *Corpus* of the sun, the sun’s power and brilliance are not also present; if they were not there, then the sun’s power and brilliance would not stand there either. One power and brilliance simply catches the other: The depth is hidden with its brilliance. If **God** willed it, the entire depth would be a sheer sun; it would only be a matter of the ignition, so that the water would be swallowed up and the water would become a spirit, then the sun's brilliance would shine everywhere; but the **Center** of the fire stands as if it wanted to ignite as it does in the sun's *Loco* <note>original: "Loco," Latin for "place" or "location."</note>.

Know also this: We understand that **God's** Heart has rested from eternity; but with the movement and breathing-in, the Essence has been revealed in all places, even though in **God** there is no place or limit, except only in the creaturely person of **Christ**; there the entire Holy Trinity revealed itself in one creature, and thus through the creature also through the entire heaven.

Since the soul of her child is now in the **Holy Trinity**, what do you think here—since she [the soul] proceeded from the mother’s essences—whether the holiness of the child, especially his high light, might not shine beautifully within the mother? Whether this mother does not rightly stand upon the moon and despise the earthly, as is seen in the **Revelation** <note>A reference to Revelation 12:1, describing the "Woman Clothed with the Sun" with the moon under her feet.</note>. For she has given birth to the Savior of all the world,

<column-break/>

without earthly mixing, and is a Virgin of discipline <note>original: "Zucht," referring to spiritual modesty and purity.</note>, highly blessed in her son **JESUS** Christ, in divine light and clarity above the heavens, equal to the princely thrones of the angels. For from her proceeded the body which draws all members to itself, which are the children of **GOD** in Christ. Therefore, her radiance is above the radiance of heaven, and the radiance of her soul is in the **Holy Trinity**, where all other children of Adam who are born in Christ are also members within the one Christ **JESUS**. Or do you suppose I am making a **GOD** out of her? No, worship <note>original: "Anbetung."</note> is not due to her. For the strength to help comes alone from the Father through the Son; for in the Father alone is the source of all-power, which he speaks forth in the Son. For the power of strength is in the first <term>Principle <note>original: "Principio," referring to the Father as the foundational source or "dark fire" from which light and love (the Son) emerge.</note></term>, which is the Father himself, and the Son is his love and light. Thus the Virgin Mary dwells in heaven in the light and in the love of the Father, and not in the strict and sharp power of **God** the Father, just as all other saints do. But as for the fiction <note>original: "gedichtet," implying something fabricated or poeticized rather than scriptural.</note> that she was taken alive into heaven with body and soul, so that she could burden herself with our distress and carry it before her son—I would like to know what understanding of the kingdom of heaven this <term>author <note>original: "Autor."</note></term> who fabricated it possesses; he surely already had the kingdom of this world as his heaven. I will let it be, and it is true, that she may indeed be in heaven with body and soul, but with such a body as Moses and Elijah had on Mount Tabor in the appearance before Christ; that is, in a new body from the element, for that which is corruptible belongs to the earth. If we could have subsisted in **GOD** in this [earthly] body, **GOD** would not have become man and would not have died for us. Even Christ’s apostles died, and yet they live. So it may also be that the Virgin’s body was transformed.

13. **Question:** What then is actually the difference between the Word and the Light-Soul of JESUS Christ?

**Answer:** The Word is the eternally-speaking Word / or the active, driving will of the Triune GOD toward the **creature**. The soul was the spoken word / which was meant to work and will according to the property of the eternally-speaking Word: but the soul of Adam / as the spoken, formed word / turned itself away from the Divine Speaking / into a self-willing and self-speaking / and therefore separated itself from God. Into this broken, separated word / that is, into the soul / the one Divine speaking Word gave itself once again / and turned the soul’s will back into the eternal speaking of GOD. Thus, the soul is indeed from the eternal Word / but it is not the speaking Word of GOD itself. So Christ did not take a new soul from the eternal speaking / but our soul / as the word once spoken and formed in Adam / namely, our human soul / back into the grace and union of the Godhead through His Love-Speaking / just as GOD spoke the Word of Grace into our poor, turned-away souls in Paradise after the Fall / as a center of grace for the turning-back and the new birth / which was then propagated from person to person until Mary / there the Word
