### Of the Marriage of the Soul with Sophia.

Let the world do with it what it will; remain you with me. It is but for a little while, then your beast <note>Böhme uses "beast" (*Thier*) to refer to the mortal, animalistic nature of the human body and its earthly desires.</note> will break; then you are free and stay with me. I have, however, also a law in my love, and I desire not you alone, but also your brothers and sisters in the world, who are still in part unregenerate, and whom the Driver <note>The "Driver" (*Treiber*) represents the forces of the world, the devil, or the "wrath of God" that hunts and oppresses the soul.</note> holds captive. You shall not hide and bury your pearl <note>A reference to the "pearl of great price," representing the spark of divine grace or Sophia herself within the soul.</note>, but show it to them, so that they also may come into my arms. Your mouth shall not be closed; you shall enter into my law and speak the truth. And though the Driver encompasses you and wishes to carry you off, a limit is set for your beast, determining how far it may go; the Driver cannot break it until it reaches its goal. And if he does break it, it happens only for the sake of God’s wonder-working and for your own good. All your welts (that is, streaks and wounds) from the bath of thorns <note>The "bath of thorns" refers to the trials and sufferings of earthly life.</note> shall stand as a beautiful sign of your knighthood <note>The soul is often depicted as a "knight" in spiritual combat.</note> in my kingdom; you shall have great joy in this before God’s angels, for having despised the Driver and having passed from a wild birth into an angelic <note>The original German "Englische" refers to *Engel* (angelic), not the English language.</note> birth. How you will rejoice when you think of your wild beast that afflicted you day and night, and from which you are now delivered. Since great honor now meets you in place of shame, why do you mourn? Rise up, like a flower from the earth, out of your wild beast. Or, you wild beast, do you think my Spirit is mad because it belittles you and holds you in low esteem? You say: "I am indeed your beast, and in me you were born; had I not grown, you would not be either." Hear me, my beast: I am greater than you; when you were to be made, I was your master-builder. My essences are from the root of eternity, but you are of this world and will break; I, however, live in my source eternally, therefore I am much nobler than you. You live in fierce torment; but I will set my fierce torment into the light, into eternal joy. My works stand—

<column-break/>

—in power, and yours remain in figure <note>The "figure" refers to the outward, temporary shape or appearance of things in the material world.</note>. When I am free of you, I will not take you back as my beast, but rather my new body, which I bear in the deepest root of the holy element <note>The "holy element" is Böhme’s term for the spiritual substance of the heavenly world, contrasted with the four earthly elements.</note>. I will no longer have your rough outflows of the four elements; death swallows you, but I sprout with my new body out of you, like a flower from its root. I will forget you, for the glory of God, who cursed you along with the earth, has grafted my root back into His Son, and my body grows in the holy element before God. Therefore, you are only my wild beast that grieves and plagues me here, upon which the devil rides as upon his cursed horse. And though the world mocks you, I regard it not; it does so for my sake, yet it cannot see me and knows me not; why then is it so mad? It cannot murder me, for I am not in it. But what shall the spirit say, you mad world? You are indeed my brother; the essences of my spirit reprove you. Go out of your beast, so will I go with my playmate <note>Sophia refers to herself here as the soul's "companion" or "playmate."</note> into the rose garden, into the lilies of God. Why do you stay behind and let the devil hold you? He is your enemy. He seeks only your pearl; if he gets it, then your spirit is a worm and a beast-figure. Why do you let the angelic image be taken from you for the sake of temporal lust? For your lust is only in the fragile beast; what does that help your soul? It will have eternal regret for it if you do not go out. Or what shall the Knight Christ say to it: "Have I not broken your wild beast? Did I not go into death and cut off from your soul the four elements, break the malice of the devil, and graft your soul into my power, so that your body should grow green again out of my body, out of the Holy Element before God?"

...kindling of the new life; namely, of the Divine and heavenly **Mercury** <note>original: "Mercurii". In this mystical context, Mercury (Mercurius) represents the sixth "source-spirit" or property of nature: the power of speech, sound, and the movement of the spirit.</note> of **JESUS Christ**, from which the spiritual mind, the heavenly senses, affections, languages, teachings, and deeds in a newborn human take their origin. To recognize this thoroughly and to distinguish it from all falsehood, we will consider:

I. How the **Mercury**, or the sixth source-spirit of the new life, is generated within the human being.

### 1st Question.

->How then is the sixth source-spirit generated?<-

### Answer.

When **GOD’S** desire for love dwelt in the torment <note>original: "Quaal". The author often puns on "Qual" (torment) and "Quelle" (source/quality), suggesting that the "torment" of existence is also the "source" of life.</note> of the outer world and permeated it—as the sun permeates water, or as fire permeates iron—then the outer world was a paradise. The Divine essence bloomed through the earthly, and eternal life through the mortal. But when **GOD** cursed the world for the human's sake, mortality became manifest in the human, and also in the fruit that the human was to eat. This property of mortality was previously manifest only in the **Tree of the Knowledge of Good and Evil**, by which **Adam** and his wife were tested to see if their desire would enter into eternity (as into **GOD’S** being) or into the essence of time—into the living or the mortal oil—and in which quality the soul-spirit would live (that is, burn).

Thus, through **GOD’S** cursing or fleeing, the heavenly body was closed off, and the quality of wrath became manifest, and it remains so closed. Because the human was placed from eternity—in one part of body and spirit—through the eternal **Mercury** (that is, through the **Word of Divine Power**), no one could unlock the poisonous death or break the mortal **Mercury** and set it back into the quality of light (as into the quality of **GOD’S** kingdom of joy) except for the Divine **Mercury** Himself: the Power and the **Word of Life** itself. For the serpent’s poisonous earthly property had become manifest and active in the human; therefore, when **GOD’S Word** took pity on the human's ruin and took him up again, He said: The woman’s seed

<column-break/>

shall crush the serpent’s head, and you (meaning the serpent’s poison or fire) will sting his heel.

In this lies the **Philosopher's Stone** <note>original: "Stein der Weisen". Here used as a metaphor for Christ or the spiritual transformation that turns the "base metal" of the fallen human soul into "spiritual gold."</note>: how the woman’s seed crushes the serpent’s head. This happens in spirit and in essence, both temporally and eternally. The serpent’s sting is **GOD'S** wrath-fire; and the woman’s seed is **GOD'S** love-fire. This love-fire must be awakened again to shine through the wrath, taking away the power of the grimness and placing it into the Divine kingdom of joy. Thus the dead soul, which lay swallowed up in **GOD’S** curse, arises. When the poisonous **Mercury**, which resembles **GOD’S** wrath, is tinctured <note>original: "tingiret". An alchemical term for the process of transformation or "staining" a substance with a higher power to change its nature.</note> with love, then out of the death-anguish in **Mercury** comes the highest kingdom of joy and a desire for love. This desire itself creates a love-essence within, like a heavenly body emerging from the earthly one. When **Mercury** is set into the heavenly quality, it no longer desires the earthly mortal life, nor the four elements, but only the **One** <note>The "Quintessence" or the single pure element of the heavenly world.</note> in which the four elements lie hidden, as if swallowed up. Just as light keeps the darkness swallowed up within itself (and is indeed within itself, yet not manifest in the light), or as **GOD** dwells in time and time does not grasp Him—unless time is raptured into eternity so that the Divine light shines again in its quality—only then is time with its wonders made manifest in eternity. Just as the eternal **Word**, as the heavenly Divine **Mercury**, became human in the Divine Power and killed death, and set the wrath in the human (as the **Mercury**) into the Divine kingdom of joy; there, the human **Mercury**, which was previously locked in **GOD’S** wrath as in the torment of death, was again...

This is the reason / why the most fierce and poisonous **Mercurialists** <note>In Böhme’s theosophy, a "Mercurialist" is someone whose dominant spiritual quality is Mercury—the spirit of movement, expression, and communication. The more driving / poisonous, and high-ascending the **Mercury** of the natural soul is / the more friendly / lovely / powerful / constant, and joyful it becomes in the kindling of the new life. The heavenly **Mercurialists** press through everything with their spirit / they distinguish between Heaven and Hell / they test / taste / and awaken all source-spirits in the creatures / they are the true **Divine Magi** <note>original: "Göttliche Magi". Not stage magicians, but spiritual practitioners who understand the deep "Magic" or creative power of God’s Word.</note> / who may affect and change all things. For it is this **Mercury** / who stirs all things / and applies itself to all things / and wherever it takes hold / there it kindles the new life of **JESUS Christ** / but it remains fixed and constant in all fire-trials / because it has passed through death / and endured the fire of **God’s** wrath.

Thus we understand by this **Mercury** nothing other / than that source-spirit / which rises out of the kindling of the new life / and awakens the whole new human being / from which arise the inner senses / sight / hearing / smell / taste, and feeling / the judgment / the testing / the resounding and ringing out <note>original: "Hallen und Schallen". A poetic way of describing the expressive, vocal nature of the Mercury spirit.</note> of the inner human.

2. **Question.** What then does this **Mercury** actually effect in the kindling of the new life?

**Answer.** Depending on how the new life is working in a person / so too is the rising

<column-break/>

source-spirit. If the person is in the **Chamber of Repentance** <note>original: "Buß-Kammer". A metaphorical space of deep prayer and penitence.</note> / then **Mercury** rises up in such a quality / and awakens all the other source-spirits / tests / affects / and drives toward repentance / resounding and ringing out even in the external word / to awaken everything toward repentance and a change of mind. And where it applies itself in another person / it is very strict / sharp / bitingly-attractive / and quick / also powerfully driving toward conversion ; it is very hungry to kindle the new life in its neighbor / and if it can move and affect the same in brotherly love / it becomes highly joyful / it instructs / admonishes / rebukes him quite gently / helps to pray for them / wrestles for them with the devil / if one insults or curses him / he blesses / he yields to no wrathful person / nor does he flatter any power / but goes straight through / albeit in humility and gentleness. This spirit is it / that drives the preachers of repentance / prophets / and earnest disciplinarians. And if it were set into a zeal by the current wrath-torment of the world / so that it brought fire from heaven / it would not be displeasing to **GOD**. For it is not out of selfhood / nor out of one's own fire-kindling / but the source-spirit is awakened by the godlessness of men / against which it has applied itself in admonition and rebuke. If the person is kindled for prayer / then this **Mercury** presses through everything / until it affects **GOD’S** heart / it applies itself so much to **God’s** heart / that it turns away in no manner / until it reaches its satisfaction and hearing / be it for itself / or for its brothers / or for a people / land / kingdom, and world. O what this spirit is capable of / when it wells up from the fire-kindling of the heart / and awakens all source-spirits for prayer and intercession. As in the harsh quality it draws **God’s** heart so much to itself / and applies itself so sharply to it / until it kindles it with its hunger and desire. In the other quality it breaks through all hindrances / and unlocks heaven / even if it were made of iron. Out of anguish it ascends like a flash of lightning / and kindles the bowels of Divine Mercy / the greater the need is / the more powerful it becomes in prayer, etc. If the person is in the **Battle of Faith** / then this source-spirit rises out of the kindling of the new life with great power / it unlocks everything / even if hard rocks stood in the way / it leads the soul into the freedom and joy of faith. This **Mercury** in the torment of faith is the true **Divine Magus** <note>original: "Göttliche Magus".</note> / and a key in all of nature / to open all centers : **Divine Magic** <note>original: "Magia Divina".</note> stands open to him / to carry out **God’s** wonders from all centers. This **Mercury**, when it rises from the kindling of the new life in the power of faith in the heart / is the only true prophet, powerful...

### Part 4 / Chapter 10.

...words and deeds. According to its harsh quality, it can lock away; according to its bitter quality, it can open. It leads captivity captive, it awakens the dead, it calls to those things which are not as though they were; it takes where nothing is, it moves mountains, and it passes through fire and water. **In summary** <note>original: "Summa"</note>, this **Mercury** <note>In theosophy, Mercury is the "source-spirit" of sound and communication that bridges the inner and outer worlds.</note> is the magical ground through which everything can be accomplished. Its power is unspeakable, and the depth of this source-spirit—rising up out of faith—is unfathomable. It becomes especially powerful in the strong **compression** <note>original: "Compression"; the force of contraction or drawing inward.</note> of the angst-source <note>original: "Angst-Quall." The author uses "Quall" as a pun meaning both "torment" and "wellspring/source" (Quelle).</note>, where it shatters the anxiety with great power and breaks through all opposition, obstacles, tribulation, and temptations, not resting until it reaches the freedom of the spirit. Just as the Divine Power—as the Word or Heart of GOD—leads the stern Father into gentleness, so does Mercury lead its mother, the Desire, into a gentle Divine source-working.

The Mercury that rises out of the quality of the Light, causing the shine and brilliance within that Light, brings a Divine understanding to the soul and is an opener of the Divine senses. Through this Mercury, the inner eye becomes seeing, knowing, and discerning; nothing in nature or grace remains hidden from it. For the Mercury in the Light is a master of **Theology, Philosophy, and Astronomy** <note>The three traditional branches of knowledge, here understood as the study of God, the Earth, and the Heavens.</note>; it opens the wonders of GOD from the **Great Mystery** <note>original: "Mysterio Magno"; the chaos or "matrix" from which God brings forth the universe.</note>. Its hearing becomes very sharp, able to distinguish the sound of the Divine Mercury and to grasp God’s will and Word; for this Mercury penetrates into the heart of GOD and moves the living Word to speak. It opens GOD’s mouth, and GOD’s Word in the eyes and ears of the newborn human, inclining them into the heart of JESUS Christ. Here also originates the inner taste, smell, and feeling of the soul; for Mercury enters into all things and tests all spirits to see if they are of GOD—all angels and souls of men, heaven and hell, along with all their wonders and growths. It knows their colors, powers, and virtues by their taste: whether the Divine Mercury from the new life of JESUS Christ is within them, and whether the plant, flower, and fruit have the right taste, smell, color, virtue, and form that befit the life and the impulse of the Spirit of JESUS Christ. When the senses are awakened in the new life, Mercury leads and moves them so that they grasp the true essence of the Holy Element in faith, constantly drawing the little spirit-water from the little wellspring of salvation <note>An allusion to Isaiah 12:3, "With joy you will draw water from the wells of salvation."</note> of Divine gentleness, applying it to their soul-fire so that the light rises and illuminates the mind with the brilliance of Majesty.

What joy and friendship arises there is impossible to describe with any pen. In this sixth quality of the new life stand the Holy Names as the Divine powers in the opening of the Unity, in working and willing; they stand in both fires—in the fire of natural mobility and in the fire of the love-flame. Here the wonder-working Word stands in its operation, for the great name of GOD, the **Tetragrammaton** <note>The four-letter Hebrew name of God (YHWH), considered the "center" of all spiritual power.</note>, is the **center** <note>original: "Centrum"</note> of Divine wonders and is the ground of the entire **Kabbalah** and **Magic** <note>original: "Cabbala und Magia"</note>; for these are the active powers where the Insentient works together with the Sentient. There is nothing that can open this center of powers in the Tetragrammaton or the name **Jehovah** except this Mercury, which goes forth from the kindling of the new life and its seven golden lampstands. Everything that the spirit Mercury sealed and locked away in **Adam** with its seven seals of the dark world, the spirit Mercury opens again in the second **Adam, Christ**, and turns the seven seals into seven burning torches. This is the reason why the most grim and poisonous "Mercurialists" <note>Those whose spiritual temperament is dominated by the "Mercury" quality—often restless, sharp, or intense people.</note> become the noblest and most glorious instruments in the Rebirth. The more driving, poisonous, and high-ascending the Mercury of the natural soul is, the more friendly, lovely, powerful, constant, and joyful it becomes in the kindling of the new life. They are the true Divine Magi <note>A term for spiritual seekers who understand the hidden workings of God within nature.</note> who are able to affect and change all things. For it is this Mercury that moves all things and engages with all things; wherever it takes hold, it kindles the new life of JESUS Christ. Yet it remains fixed and constant in all trials by fire because it has passed through death and endured the fire of God’s wrath.

Thus, by this Mercury, we understand nothing other than that source-spirit which rises out of the kindling of the new life and awakens the entire "new man." From this arise the inner senses: sight, hearing, smell, taste, and touch—along with judgment, the power of testing, and the resonance and sound <note>original: "Hallen und Schallen"</note> of the inner being.

source-spirit. It also resonates in the outer word to awaken everything toward repentance and a change of mind. It does not yield to any fire of wrath, nor does it flatter any worldly power, but proceeds with sincerity, albeit in humility and gentleness. This is the spirit that drives the preachers of repentance, the prophets, and the earnest disciplinarians. Oh, what this spirit can achieve when it wells up from the fire-kindling of the heart and awakens all the source-spirits for prayer and intercession! In its "harsh" quality, it draws God’s heart so firmly to itself and applies itself so sharply until it has kindled that heart with its own longing and desire. In its "bitter" quality, it breaks through all obstacles and unlocks heaven, even if it were made of stone. Out of anguish <note>original: "Angst"</note>, it flashes forth like a bolt of lightning and kindles the depths of Divine Mercy; the greater the need, the more powerful it becomes in prayer, etc.

If a person is in the "struggle of faith," then this source-spirit rises from the kindling of the new life with great power; it unlocks everything, even if hard rocks stood in the way. It leads the soul into the freedom and joy of faith. Mercury in the "source of faith" is the true Divine Magus and a key in all of Nature to open every center: Divine Magic <note>original: "Magia Divina."</note> stands open to it, allowing it to bring forth God’s wonders from every center. <margin>Question 4. How does the new person administer the heavenly kingdom?</margin>
**Answer.** Just as Christ killed the wrath of GOD—which is the <term>Center</term> <note>original: "Centrum"</note> of eternal nature in the soul’s quality—with his love, and overcame the world and the kingdom of darkness in the world together with all its power: so do we, in the igniting of the new life and its authority, possess

The Kingdom of God is sown within us, and is awakened within us; it grows, however, like a <term>mustard seed</term> <note>A reference to the parable in Matthew 13:31-32.</note> and becomes large like a tree in Paradise, and it drives and works in growth until it reaches the crown. And once the new person reaches this crown, he becomes powerful enough to destroy the kingdom of the devil in others through the Spirit of JESUS Christ, and to possess his angelic throne. This was the purpose for which GOD created man and, after he had fallen, awakened him again to a new life: so that he might trample all his enemies under his feet in and with Christ, and rule and triumph in righteous justice and holiness for eternity.

# Chapter XI.
## Of the Holy Universal Christian Church.
->Connection.<-

We have briefly revealed how the <term>source-spirits</term> <note>original: "Quell-Geister." In the mysticism of Jacob Böhme, these are the seven foundational qualities or "energies" of God that also exist within the human soul.</note> become active in every reborn person through the igniting of the new life of JESUS Christ for the revelation of this new life—namely in repentance, prayer, faith, rebirth, knowledge, wisdom, love, and the awakening and edification of others. Now, just as all six source-spirits are active in the new person, each according to its own quality, nevertheless all their effect, drive, and labor—according to all their forms—tends solely toward reaching the seventh spirit as their complete satisfaction, their rest, their body, temple, dwelling-house, food, and perfect fullness. In this seventh spirit, they all reach their final <term>end point</term> <note>original: "terminum"</note>; all the source-spirits from the Head, JESUS Christ, as well as from the body and all members, go toward this. And this seventh source-spirit of the new life, as the "body" of all the other source-spirits, we call a holy, universal Christian Church.

---

There, all members and all believers—according to the countless types of qualities of the new life—make up a single body, and all branches make up a single tree, where each offers his life-spirit, sap, and power to the service of the other, and

### 2. Question. Why is this love called universal?

**Answer.** Because it consists of each and every <term>reborn person</term> <note>original: "Wiedergebohrnen." Those who have undergone a spiritual rebirth or "new birth" in the Christian mystical tradition.</note>, from Jews and Gentiles, from all peoples, nations, and tongues, without distinction of country, status, or age. All these are a single body, and a single tree in Christ JESUS, living and growing from one Spirit, from one sap on the single stem of JESUS Christ. This single body—the head and the members, the stem and the branches, great and small—are all a single Christ; they are ignited, driven, and worked upon by one Spirit of Life. Furthermore, from the <term>qualifying</term> <note>original: "Qualificirung." This term refers to the interaction and specific "flavor" or "operation" of spiritual properties within a person or the collective body.</note> of them all, a single Spirit goes forth, which is **Universal** in the whole body and **Particular** in every member. Thus, when Holy Scripture speaks of Christ, it understands thereby *not only* the highly blessed Person of JESUS Christ as the Head, but the entire body, and each and every faithful and living Christian in whom Christ is entirely, and who are entirely in Christ.

### 3. Question. Where then is the Community of JESUS Christ?

**Answer.** This Community of JESUS Christ is in all places where reborn people are found, in whom the Spirit and the Word of JESUS Christ dwell and work as in the Temple of Christ. For the children of Christ are Christ’s Bride; he has adorned her with his beautiful jewels so that, just as he has loved us and introduces us through himself into GOD his Father: so also should we love one another. And when a repentant, penitent sinner comes, who wishes to enter into the Community of Christ and who desires Christ, the Community shall receive him; for Christ has received him, and so we are all one body in Christ. And just as one member holds and loves another, so should we receive one another, taking the poor converted sinner into our Community and, in GOD’s stead, announcing to him the forgiveness

<column-break/>

of sins, laying our hands upon him, and making him a partaker of our body and fellowship. In this way, our spirit and power will also rest upon him, as was seen with Christ’s Apostles. When we take him into Christ’s Community, he is our brother. When we say, "your sins are forgiven," they are indeed drowned in Christ’s death and blood, and he is our member. We do not take the sins from him ourselves; rather, Christ in us drowns them through our faith and his faith, in His blood. When we lay hands upon him and pray over him, we penetrate with our will—which is in GOD—into his will, and lead him in our will, as in one body in Christ, to the Father. His will becomes our will, for through Christ he gives himself into the Bride as into our will, which is also GOD’S will. We rightly take him into our love and into our will, and sink ourselves with him through Christ into GOD; thus we forgive him his sin. For we are the Community and Bride of Christ, whom he loves: And what we do, Christ does in us, and GOD in Christ. It is all one; Christ is ours, and GOD is Christ’s, and the converted sinner is also ours, and also Christ’s, and also God’s. We live in one body, and have one spirit, and are one flesh. And as we enter into GOD’S will, so we also take the brother with us; the sin we cast behind us into the <term>wrath-fire</term> <note>original: "Zorn-Feuer." A Latin term used by Christian theosophers to describe the manifested Kingdom of Heaven or the "divine corporeality"—the spiritual substance of the New Jerusalem.</note>. The Church of JESUS Christ is in all places where living members are in Christ JESUS. When we come together, we should all bring one will into the Community, namely, the desire for Christ. # Chapter XII.
## Of the outer visible Church / and its proper ministry.

->Connection.<-

From what has been cited above, we see quite clearly wherein actually consists the true ground of the holy universal Christian Church and of true Christianity, together with its living service of the Spirit and of truth, in and for itself without any external assemblies, articles, teachings, opinions, and ceremonies, as things which do not properly belong to the true Church, GOD’S temple and dwelling-house of the Holy Spirit; thus it follows now, that we also investigate how the true invisible church is hidden in the outer visible one, and also how she is <term>qualified</term> <note>original: "qualificiret." In Böhmean theology, this refers to how spiritual properties or "qualities" operate and manifest within a person or structure.</note>, works, and lives therein, just like the new man in the old; where we then also investigate the true service and the true teaching-office of the New Testament.

If this new life of JESUS Christ is not active and driving within, then all is <term>Babel</term> <note>original: "Babel." The holy person has his church within himself, where he hears and teaches from within. But Babel has a heap of stones, where she goes in to practice hypocrisy and outward show; she lets herself be seen in beautiful clothes and acts devout and pious. The stone church is her God, in which she places her trust. The holy person, however, has his church in all places, with him and in him. Whether he stands or walks, lies down or sits, he is in his church; he is in the true Christian church, in the temple of Christ. The Holy Spirit preaches to him from all <term>creatures</term> <note>meaning all of God's created works in the natural world.</note>; everything he looks upon, there he sees a preacher of GOD.

Here the mocker will say that I despise the stone church where the congregation gathers. To that I say: No. Rather, I point to the hypocritical <term>Babylonian Whore</term> <note>A common 17th-century polemic for the institutional church when it is perceived as corrupt or spiritually empty.</note> who only commits adultery with the stone church; she calls herself a Christian but is the child of a whore. A right Christian brings his holy church with him into the congregation. His heart is the true church where one should practice the service of GOD. If I go to church for a thousand years, and even take the Sacrament every week, and let myself be absolved every day—if I do not have Christ in me, it is all false and a useless trinket, a piece of <term>carved work</term> <note>original: "Schnitz-Werck." He sighs and wishes constantly that God’s will might be done in him and His kingdom be made manifest in him. He kills sin in the flesh daily and hourly. For the <term>seed of the woman</term> <note>A biblical reference to Genesis 3:15, interpreted here as the "inner man" or Christ within the believer, who overcomes the "serpent" of worldly vanity.</note>, as the inner man in Christ, constantly treads upon the head of the devil in vanity. For Christ says: *Whoever believes in me will never die, but has passed through from death into life.* Also: *Streams of living water will flow from him* <note>John 7:38</note>, as good doctrine and works. And although there are many kinds of gifts and levels of knowledge among GOD’s children, they do not quarrel about them, nor do they separate themselves; for these gifts all come from one root—namely, the kindling of the new life—and are worked by one Spirit, though in various vessels. They rejoice together in the great wonders of GOD and thank the Most High in His wisdom; for the kingdom of GOD consists not in <term>opinion</term> <note>original: "Meinung." Also, Christ said and left it to his disciples at the last: that they should love one another; by this everyone would know that they were his disciples, just as he had loved them. If people sought love and righteousness as much as they sought after opinions, there would be no strife on earth. We would live as children in our Father and would need no law nor order. Love and a joyful obedience. Laws are for the sake of the wicked, who do not desire love and righteousness; they are driven and compelled by laws. We all have only one single <term>Order</term> <note>meaning a religious rule or way of life, such as a monastic order.</note>, namely that we remain still before the LORD of all beings, and surrender our will to Him, and let His Spirit work in us, play, and do what He wills; and what He works and reveals in us, we give back to Him as His fruit.

Thus the true church actually consists of no others than such members who, through the Spirit of *JESUS* Christ, crucify, kill, and bury their <term>old man</term> <note>A biblical term for the unregenerate, sinful nature before spiritual rebirth.</note> along with his lusts and desires, die to all <term>selfhood</term> <note>original: "Selbstheit." ### 3. Question: What then is actually called Babel, or the false church?

**Answer.** We actually call the false church the "great heap" of those people who in no way die to their selfhood and own-will, but rather seek to preserve their own life in unrighteousness, greed, pride, lust, gluttony, drunkenness, and all fleshly desires and cravings, and thus in no way attain the life of *JESUS* Christ and the true <term>Re-birth</term> <note>The spiritual process of being born again into a new life.</note>. Nevertheless, they boast of Christ and His precious merit, falsely claiming His righteousness and satisfaction for their sins, and imagine that they are accepted as children of GOD out of presumed grace because of certain opinions and articles, as well as outward ceremonies and worship; and thus they present everything that true children of GOD actually possess in the Spirit as a false appearance of wisdom. This is compared to <term>Babel</term> <note>referring to the Tower of Babel (Genesis 11), symbolizing human confusion and prideful attempts to reach God through institutional effort.</note>, the tower that <term>Nimrod</term> <note>A biblical figure described as a "mighty hunter," here interpreted as a symbol of tyrannical power and the origin of institutionalized religion.</note>, a mighty hunter before the Lord from the lineage of Ham, once erected, intending thereby to force all peoples under one opinion and dominion.

So understand us rightly as to what Babel and the Tower of Babel signify. The city of Babel is the <term>Ham-man</term> <note>referring to the descendants of Ham, often used symbolically for those who live according to the flesh rather than the spirit.</note> who builds this city

<column-break/>

upon earth; the tower is his own chosen god and worship; all "Reason-scholars" from the school of this world are the master-builders of this tower. All those who set themselves up as teachers and are called to it by men without GOD’S Spirit, these are all foremen on this tower and idol of the world, and no one else; they all merely carve stones and wood for this tower. For the name Nimrod also shows quite clearly in its own sense of the <term>formed word</term> <note>In Böhmean linguistics, the sound and structure of a name reveal its inner spiritual essence.</note> that it is a captured, compacted lust that soars upward as its own god, whose image was the tower. GOD allowed them to represent the figure of their quality in their confused understanding, as an image of what man had become before GOD. Now Reason says: Why did GOD let that happen? It had to be so, in order that the wonderful wisdom in the <term>unformed word of the five vowels</term> <note>original: "fünf Vocalium." A mystical interpretation where vowels represent the pure Spirit or breath of God, and consonants represent the "forming" of that Spirit into matter or specific principles.</note> might introduce itself into a form or outward contemplation through the formed word of the <term>three principles</term> <note>A foundational concept in Jacob Böhme’s philosophy: the dark fire-world, the light-world, and the outward material world.</note>, as a re-modeling or shaping. For the dark world of God’s wrath had become manifest in man, from which the coarse earthly quality was born, which had also completely captured man; it also represented its image as its own god. Thus the tower was an image of the dark world, where men wanted to see GOD in the dark selfhood; it signifies the earthly man, who stands before GOD like this tower, and is an image of Divine contemplation according to evil and good, like a painted life; for the right human life was the formed word, which in its own desire for selfhood was such an image before GOD as this tower.

Here there is no counsel / unless the soul <note>Böhme refers to the soul as "she" (die Seele).</note> has the single Spirit of the sounding letters / as the unformed Word within her / so that she may draw it to herself in her desire / and clothe herself with it / so that this same Spirit may burst apart all the captured, compacted tongues and images of the letters <note>Böhme uses "letters" to represent dead, intellectual scripture or rigid dogma that lacks the living Spirit.</note> / and lead them into a single tongue and will / which is **GOD** / All in All.

Everything must return again into the One / as into the Whole: in multiplicity there is only strife and unrest / but in the One is an eternal rest / and no contrary-will. If we now wish to consider the Tower and the City of Babel <note>Böhme uses Babel (Babylon) as a symbol for the confusion caused by sectarianism and institutional religion.</note> in its formed image upon Earth / what and where it may be / we find it painted clearly before our eyes / that it consists of the great houses of the churches / monasteries and castles / as well as the strong walls and towers of the cities on Earth / where people hide themselves from violence / and in the churches / monasteries and foundations / in their opinions / they play the hypocrite before **GOD** / and cry out to him / that he should accept us in our fabricated and captured opinion of the letters. What is all this? An idolatry and hypocrisy / an Anti-Christ with glitter and appearance. What does one bring into the hypocritical Babylon? Nothing but images / and self-captured opinions from the literal form. What does one take home from this hypocritical house? Only images of the letters / into these same images the poor, captive soul encloses itself / which is nevertheless full of fear and trembling / because of the captured images / and fears always / that another people in their own captured images might break in / and destroy these images of theirs. Therefore people have made great castles and towers / and walls on cities and churches / so that they can defend themselves / so that the tower / upon which they wish to climb into heaven / might not be destroyed.

Now Reason speaks: These are surely houses of learning / where one teaches the ignorant

<column-break/>

and where one sings and prays. Look outwardly, in and among the literal-minded people / it is only the Tower and the City of Babel; but inwardly among the children of **GOD** / in whom the temple of **GOD** is / where the images are destroyed / there is Christ. This is within those / who have shattered all images and opinions within themselves / and are alone and single / through a turning-away from all images / into the single grace and mercy of **GOD** / having entered into His compassion / and made themselves entirely unworthy / nothing / and as if dead. These no longer want nor desire anything / but only the single purity of **GOD** in His loving-will / and they deem themselves far too unworthy of any acceptance / and fall into **GOD'S** mercy in highest humility / just as if they were nothing / and cast all their desire and will into **GOD'S** mercy. Whatever He wills or does in them / that is what they also will / and nothing more. In those, I say / is a house of learning and a house of hearing / a temple of **GOD** / where the Spirit of **GOD** in the soul teaches / hears / prays / sings and praises **GOD** / for they have died to all selfhood <term>selfhood: *Selbstheit*, the ego-driven state of being separated from God's will</term> / self-willing and opining / and play solely in the praise of **GOD** in the knowledge of the Holy Spirit / these are the Church of Christ.

<margin>Mysterium Magnum <note>The "Great Mystery," Böhme's 1623 commentary on Genesis.</note> chapter 36, paragraphs 43, 60.</margin>
So much for the true and false Church in general. Now follows specifically concerning the teaching and preaching office.

5. **Question:** We have indeed heard above / in what the true teaching-office of the New Covenant and the service of the Spirit consists: But the question is / whether **GOD** then uses no outward means for the repentance and conversion of man?

**Answer:** Because man has set his will so firmly in the visible kingdom of this world / and scattered his senses into outward objects / it cannot be denied / that **GOD** uses not only internal means / to entice, draw, and call man into his inward ground <term>inward ground: *inwendiger Grund*, the deepest part of the soul where God dwells</term>; rather He uses such tools / which direct the sensory, externalized human being away from all vanity and earthliness / and show him **GOD'S** counsel and
<meta>Will</meta>

He concludes by addressing whether God uses outward means, such as the preaching office, to guide humans back to their "inward ground."</summary>

## Of the Outward Visible Church.

...to present [His] will / through the teaching and preaching of the Divine Word. Such instruments <note>original: "Werck-Zeuge" — literally "work-tools." Böhme views humans as instruments played upon by God.</note> were first the Holy Apostles and teachers of the Christian Church / who were reborn through the Spirit and Word of JESUS Christ and ignited into a new life / they who had the power / of both the death and the resurrection of JESUS Christ / at the very foundation of their hearts / and had progressed so far / that the ignition of the new life within them reached the **sixth source-spirit** <note>In Böhme’s complex mystical system, there are seven "source-spirits" (Quellgeister) or qualities of nature. The sixth represents sound, speech, and meaningful expression.</note> in such purity and virtue / that the Spirit / and the Word of JESUS Christ itself works / teaches / and carries out the Apostolic office in them / and proves upon all consciences and souls of men the power of the death and resurrection of JESUS Christ / how we must die to selfhood and false self-desire in Christ’s death / and be born out of Christ’s Spirit into another new will and desire from Christ’s love in true living knowledge / and thus preach and teach Christ out of ourselves. For as soon as the new life is ignited in the soul / it drives toward the revelation of its own nature. Just as a little tree is planted / it works for so long / until it brings branches / and afterward fruit. Thus must the branch of the soul / which indeed stands hidden in a dark valley / always work / so that it may come to a fruit / which is the noble and beautiful **knowledge of GOD** / when the same has grown within it / so that the soul knows **GOD** / then it gives its beautiful fruit / which are good works of teaching and virtues / leads to the Kingdom of **GOD** / helps to plant and build the Kingdom of **GOD** / and is then a right worker in Christ’s vineyard.

I say it freely and openly / that everything / which is patched together from delusion and opinions / wherein man himself does not have Divine knowledge / and conclusions are made about and from that / that is **Babel** <note>A reference to the Tower of Babel, symbolizing the confusion of tongues and the "dead" intellectualism of competing religious sects.</note> / a harlotry / for it must not be done by conceit / nor by delusion / but by knowledge in the Holy Spirit. The children of **GOD** have spoken / driven by the Holy Spirit : They have planted many and various trees / but they all stand upon one root / which is the inner heaven; no one can

<column-break/>

find those [trees] / unless he also stands upon that same root / therefore the outward heaven cannot find / or master them : And the words of the Holy children of **GOD** remain a hidden **mystery** <note>original: "Mysterium"</note> to the earthly man / and though they think / they understand them / they yet have no more than a glimmer <note>original: "Glast" — a reflection or faint shine.</note> of them.

->Epistle II. 37. 40.<-

**6. Question:** Is it then permitted for every Christian to be such a teacher, as soon as the new life is awakened and ignited within him?

**Answer:** We here rightly distinguish between a general calling of Christians to work for the edification of their neighbor, and a special calling to the office of teaching and preaching. Concerning the former, it is not only permitted, but the righteousness and the right of JESUS Christ requires it : that, just as sin propagates from one person to another unto death and damnation, grace also propagates from one to another, through Christ’s Spirit and Word unto eternal life. Just as a plant propagates itself, and as one light ignites another, so also does one gift of **GOD** ignite another, so that we may refresh ourselves in one love, which is Christ in us all. A true Christian is in the spirit and [is a] Christ, and in constant exercise of his self-form to give birth / not alone with words in sound / but in the power of the work as a visible, tangible form / not to give good words from within out of one’s own selfhood / and remain in that selfhood / but to die / and in the will of **GOD** in the love of selfhood <note>This implies the transformation of the individual will into a divine will.</note> / to sprout forth as a servant of **GOD** in **GOD’S** wonder-deed / to help strike His instrument in **GOD’S** will / and to be a sounding string in **GOD’S** stringed-play / in **GOD’S** hall / as an ongoing, creative word in the **Word of Becoming** <note>original: "Verbo Fiat" — Latin for "the Word: Let there be." Böhme uses this to refer to the active, creative power of God's speech.</note> / which creates and works in and with **GOD** / what **GOD** makes, creates and works / as an instrument of **GOD**.

Therefore, you worthy Christendom, examine yourself, whether you are now in the working Wo...

...whether you work the Word of GOD in His will, or whether you only stand in the outward form of Christianity, and work your own self-interest in falsehood. 7. **Question:** Should it not cause a great disorder if every newly-awakened person immediately wanted to be a teacher?

**Answer:** One must distinguish well between a general member and brother—who builds up, admonishes, rebukes, comforts, and awakens his neighbor in Christian love through words and deeds—and an Apostle or teacher, who is equipped and called by GOD to the office of teaching with special gifts of the Holy Spirit and the demonstration of the power of GOD. The former teaches in a quiet manner, more through his conduct than through many words, according to his gift and according to the measure and quality of the Spirit that rises out of his <term>life-ignition</term> <note>original: "Lebens-Anzündung." This refers to the moment the soul is "lit" by the Divine Fire/Light, beginning its spiritual life.</note>. If he is in a state of repentance, he proclaims repentance; if he is practiced in prayer, he will urge all to prayer; if he is in faith, he awakens others to faith; if he has light, wisdom, and knowledge, he shines before others in a holy life; if he burns in love, he ignites love in others, and so forth. And just as his <term>Mercury</term> <note>original: "Mercurius." In alchemy and Böhme’s theology, Mercury represents the principle of movement, sound, and the "word" or "vibration" that characterizes a person's inner nature.</note> has a specific quality in its life-ignition, so too will the one who has been awakened commonly have a certain qualification and enkindling of life. Thus, every member is bound to apply his gifts and powers for the benefit and salvation of the other members. Of this general calling in the living communion of JESUS Christ, the Author <note>Referring to Jacob Böhme himself.</note> speaks most pleasantly:

> I rejoice in my soul when I hear that a powerful, beautiful little branch has sprouted on our Tree of Life, Christ, and I hope to enjoy its good fruit as well. Just as one branch on a tree enjoys the sap and power of another, and all grow and bear fruit in one single power: so we also are all only One in the tree of Christ, which is Christ in us all. Because you then freely and publicly confess this Tree of Life with mouth and heart, and conversely renounce the poison and error of Satan, I now desire nothing more than that I might be able—in the power of this tree, which is Christ—to pour into you my power received from Him, so that we as members may grow in one power. And I have no doubt that the Most High has birthed His <term>lily-branch</term> <note>The "Lily" is Böhme’s symbol for the coming age of spiritual purity and the blossoming of the soul in divine wisdom.</note> in you; for without Divine power we have no desire nor...

**8. Question: Are some still equipped by GOD today with a special power of the Spirit to proclaim the Gospel?**

**Answer:** All those whom GOD leads in a special way through the <term>Process</term> <note>original: "Proceß." In this mystical tradition, the "Process of Christ" refers to the believer internally experiencing the stages of Christ’s life—specifically his suffering, death, and resurrection—as a spiritual transformation.</note> of the suffering, death, resurrection, and ascension of JESUS Christ, so that the power of Christ's death has become powerfully effective in them, for the killing of sin in the flesh, and the power of the new life of JESUS

<column-break/>

Christ is effective in them for true rebirth; these are the ones whom GOD calls as witnesses both of the death and the resurrection of JESUS Christ, so that they testify and speak of what they have seen, heard, and livingly experienced. Of this calling our author speaks very gloriously under the image of Abel. When the earnest <term>struggle of repentance</term> <note>original: "Buß-Kampff." A term used to describe the intense, often painful spiritual conflict a person undergoes when turning away from their old life toward God.</note> and the conflict in the soul begins / so that the will of all selfhood shall die / and the soul in all the assaults and temptations of the Devil / the world / and the flesh does not yield from its earnest purpose in any way / so that the process of JESUS Christ in the soul proceeds with strong zeal from strength to strength / so that the soul cries out to GOD in prayer / and seeks death for the <term>animal image</term> <note>original: "thierischen Bild." This refers to the fallen, earthly nature of man that is driven by instincts and pride rather than the Divine Spirit.</note> with earnestness / then a great storm arises in the body / and seeks the gates of the deep in its origin / and presses with power into the Word / that formed it as a creature / and sinks down into it / as a weak child without a will of its own / and desires its first mother / from whom its first soul was born for nursing / and makes itself entirely without will in that same mother / lying only at her breast / and sucks into itself her love and grace; the mother may do with it what she will. This means, then, that selfhood and self-pleasure die within / and the soul's will becomes like a child / as Christ says: Unless you turn back and become as children / you shall not see the kingdom of GOD. For selfhood and self-reason in the lusts of the flesh / can neither taste nor see it.

From such an earnest surrender and the dying of the self-willed ego in GOD’S mercy / the virgin child sprouts forth again from the wilderness with its beautiful <term>pearl-tree</term> <note>original: "Perlen-Bäumlein." A mystical symbol common in the writings of Jakob Böhme, representing the growth of divine wisdom and the "pearl of great price" within the soul of the believer.</note> / with very beautiful and new fruit. For thus it must be proven in the fire of GOD’S wrath / so that the disgust of the introduced earthly will may die within it. For the <term>fire-soul</term> <note>original: "Feuer-Seele." This refers to the soul in its primary, energetic state, which must be tempered by light and love to reach a state of grace.</note> / as the first principle / hangs on the bond of the outer world / and always gladly takes something of vanity into itself.

# On the Outer Visible Church.

...only / what a heavy account you shall give! With you, only "skill" <note>original: "Kunst." In this context, it refers to academic learning, cleverness, or intellectual theologizing as opposed to spiritual wisdom.</note> shall count / and in Christ’s kingdom, such skill is but filth. **GOD** leads a pure heart with his Spirit / that approaches him / and surrenders to his will / that person he teaches heavenly skill. The congregation of Christ shall be of one will / and its shepherd shall have the spirit and will of the congregation.

It is not such a trivial thing to put on the robe of Christ <note>A metaphor for taking up a clerical office or identifying as a Christian.</note> / as many think / who only seek greed and honor in it. He shall surely find **GOD’S** wrath therein. Or what shall one say? The priest-devil <note>original: "Pfaffen-Teufel." A derogatory term used by reformers and mystics to describe the spirit of corruption, greed, and power-seeking within the clergy.</note> has blinded the kingdom of Christ / so that the congregation of Christ is stone-blind / where one thinks / they are gods / and teach from the Holy Spirit / even though in falsehood their own honor and greed are sought. One sees / what great misfortune they have caused in the world / how many a land they have devastated / and with their false opinion murdered many hundred thousand people / and only served the devil in Christ’s robe. If the congregation could only see / they would realize this. This all comes from / not granting the Spirit of Christ the honor; people want to choose shepherds themselves / and yet the devil is in every human choice / when it concerns **GOD’S** honor and teaching. The self-grown bishops chosen by favor without **God’s** Spirit are as useful to the world / as a fifth wheel on a wagon / except that they lead the congregation astray / make them blaspheme and quarrel / as their polemical books <note>original: "Schmäh-Bücher," referring to the aggressive theological pamphlets common during the religious conflicts of the 17th century.</note> prove / in which there is as much **fear of God** / and love for one’s neighbor / as the devil has in hell. Blood-drums are they / the devil’s army-drum / with which he mocks the simple congregation of Christ.

O dear children / open your eyes wide / go out from the priest-quarrels / and enter into the struggle / against the devil / and against voluptuous flesh and blood.

->The Threefold Life 14. 13. 14. 15.<- <note>A reference to Böhme’s own work, "The Threefold Life of Man."</note>

<column-break/>

Dear children of Christ / stop up your ears / against the blaspheming wolves / for they damage not only themselves / but the congregation of Christ / which is everywhere in all lands / where repentant people are. They are the cause / that the church of **GOD** is so devastated / and poor people quarrel among each other for mere opinion / and run about in the Anti-Christian kingdom from one opinion to another / and know not / which is the best / for they have gone out from the paradise of Christ. They boast of Christ’s teaching / and yet they deny it with their power <note>Likely a reference to 2 Timothy 3:5, "Having a form of godliness, but denying the power thereof."</note> / and they testify that Christ is not in them. They do not even want to have him in them / they thrust him / with his body and blood / with his humanity out of the congregation; they only want to have a sign of him / so that they can thus in their pride occupy Christ’s place / and all be fine, rich, fat bellies. **10. Q.** Who then is actually the Antichrist, against whom the author warns so earnestly?

**Ans.** Just as we understand by "Christ" not only the highly blessed Person, the Head and our **LORD**, but also all the members who are reborn in Christ through the Spirit and the Word, and who have led their "old man"—along with his lusts and desires in selfhood—unto death, and who are awakened to a new life: so also the Antichrist is called the "man of sin" and the "child of perdition" in his own will and in his <term>old-Adamic fire-power <note>original: "alt-Adamischen Feuers-Macht." This refers to the raw, unregenerate human soul which is driven by harsh, "fiery" desires and pride rather than divine light and love.</note></term>, under the appearance and name of **JESUS Christ**. And just as Christ as Head and the members through His Spirit and blessing administer the threefold <term>mediatorial office <note>The roles of Prophet, Priest, and King performed by Christ.</note></term> as the covenant of the New Testament, so the Antichrist carries out his "un-teaching," has a false priesthood, and exercises tyrannical power and lordship. Christ and His apostles all preached the way of **God** in pure love and pointed us to the living **GOD**, that we should come out from our evil fleshly lusts, from lies and falsehood, from impurity, from greed and murder and theft, into a pure, chaste, humble, and God-fearing life, and trust ourselves entirely to Him as His children and recognize Him as our Father. Then He will give us rain and blessing in body and soul, and after this life will take us to Himself into His kingdom, where all our tribulations shall be eternally redeemed. Thus, the teaching of Moses, all the prophets, and also **Christ**, was nothing else than that we should turn back...

All strife and war, as well as envy and hatred, have arisen from the Antichrist throughout the world; he wishes to be honored as a God in the form of an angel, yet the devil sticks within him. 12. **Question:** How then should one depart from Babel and flee from the Antichrist, since according to this testimony he is in all parties and opinions?

**Answer:** One cannot depart from Babel and the Antichrist in the same way one moves from one religious party or sect and from one opinion to another. Whoever wishes to depart from Babel must depart from all *selfhood* <term>original: "Selbstheit"; the ego-driven nature that seeks its own will and pride rather than God's</term> through earnest repentance, and must fix their will with true obedience of faith firmly into the Spirit and Word of **JESUS** Christ, so that the new life of **JESUS** Christ may rise within them and the Spirit of Christ becomes active; thus they are reborn, free from Babel, and a living member of the Church of **GOD**. You must depart from your reason and the carnal spirit, and lead your hearts, senses, and minds <note>original: "Gemüthe"</note> entirely into obedience to **GOD**, surrendering your will into **GOD’s** will. Do not devise your own paths through reason, or ask: "Where is Christ?" Direct your path in Christ and know for certain that he is in your heart. Surrender yourselves to him in great humility, cast all your deeds and intentions into his will and pleasure, and think of nothing else but that you stand at all times and hours before the clear countenance of **GOD**

<column-break/>

and that Christ sits in you upon the rainbow at the right hand of **GOD**. Think that you stand every moment before the *Holy Trinity* <term>original: "Heilige Drey-Zahl"; literally "Holy Three-Number," Böhme's specific term for the Triune Godhead</term>: that **GOD**, the Holy Trinity, always probes and sees the abyss of your heart. Think that you do not wish to enter into any deep contemplation or searching, but only purely into his love and mercy. Also, think that you never wish to depart from it, but to remain within it eternally.

And then, secondly, think that you do the highest pleasure for **GOD** when you seek your brothers and sisters in this world—whoever they are, of whatever name or opinion they may be—with your love, enclosing them in your hearts, helping to pray for them, and wrestling with the devil for them. Also, if possible, instruct them with fine humility. But if they will not accept this, then put on the *little robe of Christ* <note>original: "Röcklein Christi"; a metaphor for adopting Christ's humility and patient character</note> and lead them by good example. Be of service to them; forgive them if they offend you. When they scold you, bless them. If they do violence to you and you cannot turn it to good or escape them, then let it go and think that you are only guests here. Withdraw your love from no one, for your **GOD**, in whom you live, withdraws from no one who merely seeks and desires him. Be ready to serve your adversary if he should ever convert. In trade and conduct, love justice; think that you perform your works for **GOD**. In this world, in this weary *vale of tears* <note>original: "Jammerthal"</note>, we must deal with business and works; we should not crawl into holes, cloisters, or corners, for Christ says: *Let your light shine before men, that they may praise your Father in your works.* <note>Matthew 5:16</note> Do everything from the whole heart with a pure mind; think that you do it for Christ, and that it is Christ's Spirit doing it in you. Be ready and expectant of the *Bridegroom* <note>The returning Christ</note> at every hour; give your heart no other room to [turn] toward any other opinion...

### The Threefold Life, ch. 12, § 34, 35.

For the Spirit of the Lord **JESUS** is full of heartfelt longing; it always goes out from him and all the saints / and encounters all those / who seek him / it is **GOD**'s seeking <note>original: "Sucht"; in this context, a passionate longing or "divine craving" for union.</note>, in which **GOD** desires humanity / for she is his image / which he created according to his humanity / in which he wants to see and recognize himself / and he also dwells in man. Why then do we search so long? Let us only seek and know ourselves. When we find ourselves / then we find **GOD** / we need not run anywhere to seek **GOD** / nor can we do him any service. If we only seek and love ourselves <note>Böhme refers here to the true "self" created in God's image, not the ego-driven "selfhood" mentioned on the previous page.</note> / then we love **GOD**: What we do to one another / that we do to **GOD**: Whoever seeks and finds his brother and sister / has sought and found **GOD**: We are all one body in him in many members / where each has his business / his governance and activity / and that is **GOD**'s wonder: We were known in his wisdom before the times of the world / and he created us into being / so that there might be a play <note>original: "Spiel"; Böhme uses the metaphor of "play" to describe the joyful, non-toilsome interaction between the Creator and the created.</note> in him. The children are our teachers / we are fools in our wits <term>original: "Witze"; the rational, calculating intellect</term> compared to them: When they are born / this is their first [task] / that they learn to play with themselves / and when they are older / they play with one another: Thus has **GOD** from eternity played with us in his wisdom in our childlike hiddenness. But when he created us into [rational] wits / we were meant to play with and among each other / but the devil envied us for this / and made us at odds in our play / therefore we still quarrel. We have nothing else / to quarrel about except in our play. When that is over / we lay ourselves down to rest and go home. Then others come to the play / and also quarrel until evening / until they go to sleep / in their

<column-break/>

land / from which they came. For we were in the land of peace / but the devil persuaded us to go into his unpeaceful land.

Dear children / what are we doing now / that we obey the devil? Why do we quarrel over a little stick / that we did not make? For this land is not ours / and this garment is not ours: It belongs to our Mother <note>The "Mother" is a frequent reference in Böhme's work to *Sophia* or Divine Wisdom, who births the spiritual life in the soul.</note> / and the devil has soiled it. We want to take it off / and go to the Mother / so that she may put a more beautiful one on us / then we need not quarrel over the little coat / which is soiled. We quarrel here over a coat / because one brother has a more beautiful little coat than the other: Yet the Mother puts on each one his little coat: Why do we quarrel with the Mother / who bore us? Are we not all her children / let us only be pious / so she will buy us all a new one / and we will rejoice / we will forget everything soiled. We walk in the rose garden / there are lilies and flowers enough / we will make a wreath for our sister / so she will rejoice before us. We have a high dance / in which we all want to join: Let us be joyful / there is no night anymore / our Mother cares for us: We go under the fig tree / take as much of its fruit as you want / how beautiful are the fir trees in Lebanon! Let us rejoice and be merry / that our Mother has joy in us. We want to sing a song of the robber <note>The "robber" is the devil, who stole humanity's peace and original purity.</note> / who made us at odds: How is he captured / where is his power? He is nowhere to be found: Moreover, he did not get the soiled little coat / that we quarreled over / the Mother has kept it / how is he so poor? He ruled over us / and now he is bound. How have you, great power, become such a mockery? You hover over the cedars / and now lie at the feet / and are so powerless. Rejoice, you heavens and you children of **GOD**: He who was our driver / who plagued us day and night / he is captured / rejoice, you angels of **GOD**.

13. Question: It certainly cannot be denied that the decay within all sects is great, and that the preaching office in all religions is powerfully corrupted; the question remains, however, whether the external teaching office, as it is administered today, has any use at all?

Answer: It has its use insofar as it directs people with genuine earnestness and living power toward repentance and conversion, showing them how to enter into the death of their own "self-will" <note>original: "Tod ihrer selbst"; Böhme's concept of "dying to the self" or the ego to allow God to act through the person.</note> and let the Spirit of **JESUS** Christ work a new life within them according to **GOD**’s will. But where it only leads people into head-knowledge, mental images, opinions, strife, and quarreling through teaching, preaching, and catechizing alone—and where it regards those who profess a certain opinion as true members of Christ while perverting and condemning others who hold different opinions, as unfortunately happens—such a teaching office is the Devil’s apostolic office, no matter how much it may glitter.

Mother Eve spoke when she gave birth to her first child: "I have the man, the Lord; he shall do it; he shall crush the serpent’s head and possess the kingdom." But it was Cain, a murderer. In the same way, you also say now: "We have found the **LORD**; now we shall possess the kingdom, for we have found the true doctrine; we will teach thus, and so we are **GOD**’s children." But listen: you may have indeed found the doctrine, but you are Cain; you only desire the kingdom and not the power of Abel’s sacrifice <note>In Böhme’s theology, Abel represents the humble, spiritual human, while Cain represents the proud, earthly human who relies on external forms.</note>. You wish only to remain in the lusts of the flesh, and you keep only the husk of **GOD**’s Word, which has no power. You hold onto the histories and fight over them, devastating land and people, but you deny the power. You say, "we are near to the Kingdom of **God**," and yet you have never been further from it; your end will testify to this. What does your knowledge help you? The Devil knows what you know as well, but he does not do it; so it is with you, and therefore the Kingdom of **GOD** remains hidden from you both. Your knowledge is the snare that catches you; if you were simple <note>original: "alber"; meaning simple-hearted or without guile, rather than foolish.</note>, then

<column-break/>

you would not be so proud. What does the simple person know of false cunning and deceit, unless they learn it from the cleverness of the *Turba*? <term>Turba: a Latin term Böhme uses to describe the "spirit of disturbance" or the "multitude" that leads to confusion and divine wrath.</term> You say, "we carry out **GOD**'s will and teach it." Are you not Cain, who murders Abel every day? Just look at yourself properly; indeed, you are he. Abel lies at your feet and pleads with you, but you are the evil beast that treads Abel underfoot; you ride over the bowed knees and regard the simple person as dust, yet you devour the fruits of his sweat and fill yourself with groundless deceit. How then can you say: "Here is the Church of Christ!"? O, you are Babel <note>Babel: representing the "City of Confusion" or the corrupt institutional church that speaks many "languages" (doctrines) but lacks the one Spirit.</note>, a city of harlotry and falsehood. You know **God**’s will and do only your own will; you even say, "we have gone out from Babel, we have the true doctrine among us." Yes, if you had the spirit of righteousness and truth, and were content with a little, the Mother <note>Refers to Divine Wisdom (Sophia) or the nurturing source of spiritual life.</note> would always give you enough; you would have no want. But your magnificence and pride do not trust **GOD**; therefore you rely only on greed and wish only to devour the fat of the earth for yourself; you take it by force and not by right. The "right" that you claim has been invented by your false, greedy heart; you live only in deceit. You persuade and deceive yourself to your own harm: if you were wise, you would look to your end and what follows after this; but you blind yourself with haughtiness and yet say: "The golden age! Many would have loved to see what we see and hear what we hear, and they did not see or hear it." Yes, listen: for it shall also be a testimony against you, and make your judgment all the heavier. You have not become better up to this point, but worse. Therefore know: what was proclaimed to you was your own prophet; he called you out of your haughtiness back into the Mother of Humility. But you have only grown worse; you have broken the Spirit's sword so that you may do what you want. But he has left you, and

# Of the External Visible Church.

...handed over to the Turba <note>original: "Turbæ"; Böhme uses this term to describe the destructive power of divine wrath or the "spirit of confusion" that breaks down structures that have turned away from God.</note>; it shall devour you, as happened to Israel in ancient times. No counsel helps; your alliances are all void: because you rely on the arm of the flesh, **GOD** has also departed from you, and lets you go so that you devour yourself. Or why do you take the covenant of **GOD** into your mouth, when you nonetheless hate discipline and seek only greed? Do you think **GOD** is a false hypocrite and a liar, as you are? Only cease from your clamor; you are not pleasing to **GOD** unless you turn back and depart from falsehood. It happens to you now as the Turba drives it; she has her delight in thus fulfilling the wrath of **GOD**, so that it devours what has grown in His kingdom, and you are blind to it and see nothing. Why do you spiritualize so much? Just go out! Do you not see how the noble Tincture <term>Tincture: In Böhme's mysticism, this refers to the spiritual "soul-light" or divine essence that has the power to transform and "transmute" the base nature into something holy.</term> has raised itself: it will very soon give its flower, then you will have silver and gold enough.

But what should one say? You have heard yourself while sleeping: You would rather go alive into the abyss before you would let the Prostitute <note>A reference to "the Whore of Babylon," symbolizing the corrupted, worldly church system.</note> go. Therefore, it shall happen to you as your own prophet shows you, who has already called to you for a long time with his trumpet; you only wait for the sword of fire, which will also cut you. Or do you think we are mad, that we speak thus? Yes indeed: we are born out of you; we see and understand the lamentation of our mother, who punishes her children, for she indicates the grimness in the Turba, which has grown even into the fierce wrath of **GOD**. We speak what is given to us, what we recognize in the zeal of the **LORD**: What have we to do with Babel <note>Babel: Symbolizes the "City of Confusion," representing the institutional churches that Böhme believed were built on human ego and division rather than the Holy Spirit.</note>? We speak with ourselves, and with the members of our own body, and those who dwell in the outer courts of **GOD**, with those who are now sorrowful with us, which sorrow shall be turned into joy.

<meta>This page continues Böhme's critique of the institutional church and its clergy. Having previously warned of divine judgment (the Turba), he now focuses on the distinction between the "Living Word" (Christ) and the "Literal Word" (the Bible as a physical or intellectual object). ### Part 4, Chapter 12

...along with its evil quality; it is fashioned exactly so. Such seed is sown by these teachers chosen by men, who desire the office only for the sake of temporal honors and pleasure, but are uncalled by **GOD** and without Divine knowledge. They do not enter through the door of Christ, but through human election out of favor, through their own will, running, and striving. These can in no way be recognized as shepherds of Christ, for they are not born of Christ nor chosen for His office. The Spirit of Christ in His children is not bound to any certain form, as if He were permitted to speak nothing more than what stands in the Apostolic letter <term>The Letter: Böhme frequently contrasts "The Spirit" with "The Letter" (der Buchstabe), meaning a purely intellectual or literal reading of Scripture that lacks spiritual life.</term>. Just as the Spirit in the Apostles was free, and they did not all speak the same words—yet they all spoke from one Spirit and Foundation, each as the Spirit gave him utterance—so also the Spirit of Christ still speaks from His children. He requires no previously assembled formula from the literal word; He Himself reminds the human spirit of what is contained in the Letter. For Christ said: *The Holy Spirit will take from what is mine and declare it to you.* Christ alone is the Word of **GOD**, who teaches the way of truth through His children and members. The literal word is only a guide and a revelation of Christ, so that man sees it standing before him as a witness of Christ—what He is and what He has done for us—so that we may draw and grasp our faith therein. But with desire, we must enter into the living Word, Christ, and be born to life within Him. They, however, say the written word is Christ’s voice. Indeed, it is the housing—the form of the Word—but the voice must be living, which drives the housing as if it were a clockwork. The Letter is like an instrument for this purpose, like a trumpet, but it requires a true sound within it,

<column-break/>

which accords with the sound in the Letter. The word of the Letter is a prepared work; whatever kind of trumpet-blower enters into it, that is how it sounds. Indeed, the great Babel <note>Babel or Babylon: In Böhme's writing, this symbolizes the "City of Confusion," representing the divided and warring denominations of the institutional church.</note> has been built entirely out of this work. Each person has blown into this trumpet of the Letter according to the sound that was within himself; and thus the sound of every trumpet-blower was accepted and brought into a substance. And that same substance is the great Babylon, where evil and good are built into one structure. If no explanation had been introduced over the Apostolic word, and if it had not been cast into other forms, the instrument would have remained pure. But the unenlightened mind has set itself up as a master over it and bent it according to its own lust. For human pleasure has seated itself therein, and shaped and explained the word according to the "fat belly" <note>A common Reformation-era idiom for greedy or worldly clergy.</note> and worldly pleasures. Thus the Spirit is extinguished, and it has become merely an Anti-Christian order and custom. The word has been shaped and grasped just like an organ-work; it is used in a custom where one plays and the others listen to the sound. Thus even now, for the most part, only such organ-players are used who strike the organ-work from the outside and make for themselves a pretty piece that they like to hear. But the organ-work only sounds as the master strikes it.
