On the Revelation of GOD in the Prophets.

# The XVI. Chapter.

## Concerning the highly enlightened Author's high gifts of Prophecy; concerning the impending judgments of GOD; concerning the fall of Babel; the destruction of the Anti-Christ in all sects; concerning various changes and revolutions of the worldly state; and the desired Lily-Time. <note>original: *Lilien-Zeit*; Böhme used this term to describe a future era of spiritual renewal and peace that would precede the end of the world.</note>

### Connection.

After we have investigated in the preceding chapters the foundation of the true and false churches, as well as the difference between the ranks and conditions of external Christianity, it now becomes necessary and fitting for us to consider our Author’s excellent testimonies concerning the changes in the form of this world in these last days. This will make us certain, through that which has already been fulfilled, to believe what may yet be in the future. That our highly enlightened Author possessed the gifts of prophecy in an uncommon measure will be denied by no one who takes to heart his prophecies, warnings, and threats with sufficient devotion, comparing them with what has already reached fulfillment from his time until our present days. I know not if I speak too much when I say that since the times of the Apostles we have not had his equal in wonder-gifts, and that these gifts of his fit so excellently into our times that one cannot sufficiently praise and laud the goodness of GOD when GOD’s faithfulness opens our eyes and presents this infallible light upon the lampstand. This is done so that we may see into these so confused, so sorrowful, dangerous, and seductive times, to notice the ways of the serpents—even if they were upon rocks—and to distinguish the essence <note>original: *Ens*; a Latin term meaning "being" or "essence," used here to describe the fundamental nature of a spiritual force.</note> of the serpents by its inner taste and smell, even if it shone as the bright sun. It allows us to recognize the senseless driving of the spirit of this world, according to all seven forms of the Sideric nature <note>original: *Syderischen Natur*; referring to the astral or "starry" influences that Böhme believed governed the physical and psychological world.</note>, in its children, and to see therein what monstrous thoughts the devil has conceived in his imagination <note>original: *Phantasiam*</note> in the dark world. In short, whoever has eyes and ears to see and hear what the Spirit presents through this glorious instrument will be able to recognize the growth of today’s world at its root, even under the finest appearance of holiness; from its driving, rising, and its constellation and other circumstances, one can determine what fruits are shortly to be expected. In particular, we shall attain in these writings a sharp and infallible sense of smell and taste, whereby we may test the countless types of prophets and spirits of this time—from what kind of fire they drive, and how strong, mighty, pure, and Divine they may be in their magical striving. We will therefore, for a better understanding, investigate: Firstly, how a prophet, as a prophet, is born. Secondly, what he does, testifies, and speaks as a prophet. Thirdly, how far his testimony extends. Fourthly, how such testimony must be tested, recognized, and accepted.

->1. Question.<-
->How then is a prophet born?<-
->Answer.<-

A prophet is such a person who is driven by a spirit that rises out of the life and fire-ignition <note>original: *Feuers-Anzündung*; a term in Böhme's philosophy for the moment spiritual energy is sparked into active expression.</note> of a people and its qualification <note>original: *Qualificirung*; the interaction of spiritual qualities.</note>, and reveals all powers, properties, virtues and vices, love and wrath of such a people, and indicates what will become of them. Just as a flower is the property of a plant's growth, so the prophet is a crown and flower of an age <note>original: *Seculi*; from the Latin *seculum*.</note> and a people. For as soon as the spring comes and the time is fulfilled, then

<column-break/>

the Sun of Righteousness, which rises in that same people, land, and age, works out of the qualification of the same in this person—who is such an extract <note>original: *Extract*; a person who represents the distilled essence of their society.</note>—and awakens the essences, so that the properties are ignited and drive downward to the root and upward to revelation. The root goes deep into that same land and people and, with its very harsh, strict property, sucks all the people’s essences into itself—in good and evil, love and wrath, virtue and vice—as they exist in a people. When these then ignite within the prophet and drive in the fire-ignition within the flash <note>original: *Blitz*; Böhme’s term for the sudden moment of enlightenment or spiritual manifestation.</note> toward revelation, then the plant rises above itself and drives until it [reaches] the flower

<meta>This page continues the introduction to Chapter 16, moving from the general praise of Jakob Böhme’s prophetic gifts to a specific explanation of how his "Magia" (spiritual wisdom) perceives the life cycles of kingdoms and the emergence of a "Prophet" at the end of an era.</meta>

...reached the flower and the crown, which through its scent, color, shape, and its entire **Signature** <note>In Böhme’s philosophy, a "Signature" is the outward form or appearance of a thing that reveals its inner spiritual character or divine purpose.</note> makes known the character of the entire plant, land, city, kingdom, and **Era** <note>original: *Seculum*; Latin for an age or century.</note>. It reveals what kind of seeds, fruits, and food shall follow—whether of wrath, leading to discipline, punishment, and total ruin; or of love, leading to mercy, grace, help, rescue, and complete redemption. This is how we must understand what our highly enlightened Author says concerning the **Magia** <note>original: *Magia*; here referring to a divine or spiritual power that understands and works with the hidden forces of nature.</note> drawn from great wonders.

A thing that grows from one beginning has both a beginning and an end, and it grows no higher than the "number" it possesses within the source from which it grew. But whatever exists as a single "number" is unbreakable, for it is only one, and nothing more. There is nothing within it to break it, for no thing that is only one can be its own enemy. However, when two things exist within one, there is already opposition and strife. One does not fight against itself, but rather draws itself into itself and out of itself, remaining one. Even if it seeks more within itself, it finds nothing more; it can never become at odds with itself because it is one thing. Wherever it goes, it goes with a single will.

But when there are two wills, there is separation; for one often desires to go inward and the other outward. If that thing then possesses a body, the **Rule** <note>original: *Regiment*; the internal order or governance of a being.</note> in that same body is divided. And if one then moves against the other with hostility, this **Contrary-Will** (which enters the other and dwells therein) becomes the "third number." This third number is a mixed being composed of the first two; it is set against both and desires to be its own entity. Yet it also holds two wills within it from the first two, where one pulls to the right and the other to the left. Thus the thing climbs from two into many, and each has its own will. If it is then contained in one **Body** <note>original: *Corpus*</note>, it is at odds with itself because it has many wills and requires a judge to separate them and keep the wills under constraint. But if these wills become strong and refuse to let the judge restrain them, but instead break out, then

<column-break/>

two **Rules** arise from one. For that which has broken out governs itself according to its own will and acts as an enemy to the first because it is no longer in harmony with it. Thus a strife begins where one desires to suppress the other and to raise itself alone as the sole being. If it cannot suppress the other, no matter how fiercely it struggles against it, each grows within itself until it reaches its "highest number" and remains in constant conflict with the other.

When it happens that it has grown to its highest number and can go no further, it enters into itself and looks to see why it can no longer grow. It sees the end of its number and sets its will upon that end, desiring to break the limit. In that very will, which it sets upon the end of the number in order to break it, the **Prophet** is born. He is his own Prophet and prophesies concerning the errors of the will—how it can no longer move forward—and concerning the breaking of the system. For he is born at the highest number, in the crown at the end of the goal. He speaks of the **Turba** <note>original Latin: "turmoil" or "disturbance." In this context, it refers to the spiritual chaos or divine wrath that arises when a system reaches its limit and begins to collapse.</note> in his kingdom, how it must end, and the reasons why it cannot step beyond its own number.

Then he prophesies of a "new thing" that shall be born again out of the breaking. For he is the mouth of that same kingdom; he points out the **Contrary-Will**, showing how the kingdom grew from one will but, through its own desire, went out of itself into many wills. He exposes the kingdom’s **Pride** <note>original: *Hoffart*</note>, its **Greed** <note>original: *Geiß*, an archaic form of *Geiz*</note>, and its **Envy**. Since the kingdom had only one root from which it grew, he points out the evil branches that have grown from that root—these are the errors and the **Turba** of the kingdom, which stifle the old tree and take away its strength and sap so that it must decay. And then he points out the falsehood of the branches which have taken the strength from the tree and only press it down to the ground. They claim they are a new tree, and a

Why do you seek so much, you wild branches? You say, we are above the Mother, we have wit and art; Why does the Mother care for your wit and art? She wants to have obedience; she desires no art nor wit, for she is quite simple, and counts only to "one"; if you want to please the Mother, you must go from multiplicity back into "one"—not through art and wit, but out of your prideful <term>Turba</term>, out of your own selves, into simple humility <note>original: "albere Demuth"; in Böhme's time, "albern" meant simple, innocent, or sincere rather than "silly."</note>; You must leave the glitter of self-wit from the <term>Turba</term>, and become as children, otherwise you are not the pleasant children of your first Mother, but

2. **Question:** If then a prophet is born, how can he announce future things beforehand?

**Answer:** From what has been stated, we see entirely how a prophet is rooted in the **specification**, and in the property of a people, of an age <note>original: "seculi"</note>, and takes on the property of the same, and reveals what will follow from such a way and order of life—be it the <term>Turba</term> in GOD’S wrath, or the breaking and destruction of such <term>Turba</term>; For that is the true ground of **magical seeing** and understanding. Every prophet is a goal <note>or "target/mark"</note> in which a spirit is enclosed; thus he is the mouth of that same spirit. When that same kingdom has awakened and born the <term>Turba</term> within itself, then he is the mouth of the inward ground, which speaks against the vanity in the <term>Turba</term>, and also of the grace of GOD, which has taken pity on human misery and withstands the grimness of the <term>Turba</term>. That is: he reveals the awakened wrath of GOD and punishes the kingdom for the sake of its vanity and idolatry, and comforts them again with the turned-in grace; for his spirit goes in the **figure** into the eternal-speaking Word of GOD, from which life was breathed out and went into a creature; there he is turned inward as an instrument of the Spirit of GOD, through which the Spirit of GOD speaks and interprets. For the prophetic spirit could not, by its own power, interpret future things that are hidden, if the Spirit of GOD did not see through him, and if the Word of GOD did not go with his word through the **magical figure** that the prophet sees; for the prophet does not know that which he interprets beforehand by his own power; but rather when the Word models itself with [the figure], then the prophetic spirit sees.

# GOD’S Seeing / how the Word of GOD passes by with the figure.
### The Great Mystery <note>original: "Myst. Mag." referencing Böhme's *Mysterium Magnum*</note> 67. §. 9. 10. 11.

Thus, no one is a prophet unless he be born within the great clockwork of Divine Order in the spoken Word, at the appointed mark <note>original: "Ziel." In Böhme’s thought, this refers to a specific point or "target" in time where divine destiny manifests.</note> of that same time, out of GOD’S Righteousness, where the Holy Spirit of GOD speaks through that same mark in Divine Order. He must be a mark in the clockwork within the <term>Great Mystery <note>original: "Mysterio Magno." This refers to the chaos or "Great Well" from which all creation, both spiritual and physical, emerges.</note></term>, through which the Spirit of GOD points toward another mark of revelation; just as the prophets were such men, and still are today, who stand at the mark of the great clockwork in the providence of grace in Christ JESUS, where GOD saw us (as in "foreseen") in Christ JESUS before the foundation of the world. He must stand within GOD’S Righteousness with his prophetic spirit, and precisely at the mark where GOD has woven the name of His love into Righteousness, so that he may be born from the ground of the law of GOD’S purpose, and then also from the ground of the appointed grace; thus he may teach the Law as GOD’S Righteousness, and also the Gospel as GOD’S Love and the fulfillment of the Law.

This man is a true prophet and no other, for he is the mark of a kingdom within the <term>Great Mystery</term>, through which and out of which the order of the kingdoms on earth originate; he is the mouth of that same kingdom. But because he must teach how GOD’S Righteousness in wrath shall be put to death by grace, and that grace must entirely surrender itself to the killing of Righteousness from before the wrath, he is also sacrificed to that same Righteousness of GOD by false prophets and Pharisees in the <term>Process of Christ <note>The "Process of Christ" is a central concept for Böhme, referring to the spiritual journey of suffering, death to the self, and rebirth that every believer must undergo.</note></term>; for this shall and must be, so that his mark may also be led through the wrath in the blood of Christ, and the mark of Righteousness be placed into grace—therefore the prophets of Christ must become martyrs.

<column-break/>

Note this well, all of you who wish to teach and believe you are called to it: look closely at your calling within yourselves, whether you are also called by GOD in His clockwork in Christ? Whether Christ has called you within yourselves with His voice? If not, then you are nothing other than false prophets who run without being sent, and do not enter through the door of Christ into the sheepfold. That you rely on a human call <note>original: "Menschen-Ruff"</note> may well be valid before men, and GOD also allows what men do to please Him when it happens in His order—especially if you surrender yourselves to GOD’S call out of a human call, and also consider how you might become capable of the Divine call within your human calling. Where that is not the case, and you remain only in a human calling in your own will, then you sit upon the **seat of the pestilence** <note>A biblical reference to Psalm 1:1, usually translated as the "seat of the scornful" or "seat of mockers."</note> and are Pharisees and false prophets. And even if there were many hundreds of thousands of you, the office does not make you prophets and shepherds of Christ unless you enter through the living door of Christ. and though this will likely not taste good to the Pharisee, the time is nevertheless born and the mark is present so that it shall be made manifest, and no human cunning helps anymore; woe to the people that despise this, they shall be consumed in the zeal of GOD’S Righteousness.

->On the Election of Grace <note>original: "Gnaden-W." referencing *Von der Gnadenwahl*</note> 12. 65. 68.<-

For this reason, **GOD** has hidden it from us, so that the earthly <term>Mystery <note>In the context of Jakob Böhme’s philosophy, the "Mystery" or *Mysterium* refers to the hidden, spiritual core of reality from which all things originate.</note></term> may bring all its wonders to completion within us, and that all the bowls of **GOD’S** wrath may be poured out within us. He has marked the Mystery with the power of the <term>Principle <note>Referring to the "Three Principles" of Böhme's divine manifestation.</note></term> in the seven forms of nature once for the wonders of **GOD**, and another time He has marked it in Love through the incarnation of **Christ** with the seven golden lampstands and torches; there it remains until the Judgment. Every "Number" reveals itself in its own <term>Age <note>original: "Seculo."</note></term>; no creature has the power to reveal it, for even he who possesses it must not, otherwise he steps out of the magical order and becomes an abomination to the Mystery. Therefore, the Prophets and even **Christ** all spoke in parables, in a magical manner; and today, no one capable of the Mystery is permitted to speak otherwise, unless it be a special purpose of **GOD** where the "Number" must stand open—such as **Daniel**, who clearly pointed to the time of **Christ** with his number; he had the command to do so.

4. Question: How could it happen then, that a true prophet, like **Jonah**, naming the time and the circumstances, yet did not see the fulfillment of his prophecy?

**Answer:** All prophets speak within the <term>Turba</term>; they point out what is false and present something better, which stands in **GOD’S** will. Thus **Jonah** showed the Ninivites the <term>Turba</term> and named the time, how soon the <term>Turba</term> would reach its goal and Nineveh would perish unless they did penance. But because they did penance, they extinguished the wrath of **GOD** and broke the <term>Turba</term>, so that Nineveh did not perish. Meanwhile, **GOD’S** Spirit, according to the quality of Love, nevertheless reached His goal—namely, the repentance and improvement of the people. Therefore, one must speak of future things in no other way than a magical manner; for the reason is this: the future wonders are all seen within the <term>Turba</term>. Now, when the Spirit declares this, He speaks out loudly how the <term>Turba</term> is laden with evil or good. He sees only that it is all mixed together; for **GOD** became man, and places His mercy over all in His wrath, and resists destruction. Now the prophet must speak magically, and not with plain words, for it often happens that a thing is already in existence, yet a little branch quickly grows out of the malice that the <term>Turba</term> [overtakes]...

5. Question: Because **GOD’S** wrath and love stand in such a mighty conflict, and often out of the ignited grimness <note>original: "Grimm." This refers to the fierce, wrathful quality of God's nature that Böhme distinguishes from His light-essence.</note> of **GOD** a little branch rises up in a people that breaks the wrath of **GOD** and damps the fire—how then should a prophet, who is urged to announce the judgments of **GOD** over a land, kingdom, <term>age <note>original: "Seculum." From the Latin *saeculum*, meaning an age, century, or the worldly spirit of a specific time.</note></term>, and people, behave so that he is not found to be a false prophet, fall into the judgment of the blasphemer, and through his prophecy harden the world even more in its wickedness?

Answer: First, he should examine himself well to see whether he is truly and thoroughly born and called to this by **GOD**. And if he has well recognized this calling, it is necessary that he not introduce his own spirit into it, nor seek or exalt himself therein, but rather separate his "I-hood" and "selfhood" <note>original: "Ichheit und Selbstheit." These terms describe the ego or the self-centered nature that must be overcome in Böhme’s theology.</note> from it. He must remain in <term>yieldedness <note>original: "Gelassenheit." A central concept in German mysticism meaning the total surrender of one's own will to God.</note></term> and humility, as a fruitful, humble little branch that itself wills nothing nor does anything, nor desires anything, but its mother’s essence; let the mother do with him what she will. The mother wants only to have humble children who lie at her breast, drink of her power, and live in her will, so that she may rejoice in them; for her fruit grows upon her little branches, which is the praise of the tongues in **GOD’S** wonder-working. It should not

<column-break/>

be understood as if I intended to despise a Christian spirit; rather, I teach in the spirit of Christ, in Him, because I must speak from the root, and this is my given office, so that we may build ourselves up in Christ—in one tree—in knowledge; and I pray that this be understood correctly. For to speak with an angel’s tongue, with the mouth of the Holy Spirit, is a great thing. Indeed, let no one ride unarmed unless the Spirit of **GOD** arms his tongue, heart, and spirit, and gives certainty; otherwise, let him not say: "The **LORD** speaks." For when the fire of the Holy Spirit often shines from the interior—as from **GOD’S** essence—through the exterior, then the external <term>Mystery <note>The *mysterium* here refers to the outward manifestation or the "astral" nature being illuminated by the inner divine light.</note></term> is ignited and becomes highly joyful, and begins to speak with tongues from the Mystery in the knowledge of the light. But the "will-spirit" should watch closely that the external spirit does not exalt itself too high and speak with tongues out of itself in the name of the **LORD**. For the external spirit triumphs when it gets a glimpse as if it were in the interior, and often rises up so full of joy; but the external "reason-spirit" from the stars <note>original: "Vernunfft-Geist vom Gestirn." Böhme warns that human logic influenced by the stars can be mistaken for divine revelation.</note> likes to mix itself in. Therefore, it is a very subtle thing to speak with the external mouth from divine tongues; the Holy Spirit must travel on the wings of the wind and direct the understanding so that the <term>disposition <note>original: "Gemüthe." A term encompassing the mind, soul, and emotional core of a person.</note></term> experiences it, for the certainty must be in the disposition. The prophet who speaks is not the certainty himself, for he speaks from two tongues: from the <term>Turba <note>A Latin term Böhme uses for the "disturbance" or the source of wrath and judgment.</note></term>, the wickedness of men, which he rebukes; and he also speaks out of love from Christ’s humanity and points the right way. But now the certainty stands in the disposition; that must be ignited and filled with the Holy Spirit. Then the mouth of the **LORD** speaks through the external mouth, not as his word, but as **GOD’S** word; alone the noble image in the interior stands as if trembling before the countenance and great power of the **LORD**.

# 4. Part / Chapter 16.

One does not truly speak words in the **LORD'S** name unless the Spirit of **GOD** first forms them; then the soul shall act like a child in obedience. And even if the **LORD** commanded fire to fall from heaven, as occurred with **Elijah**, the soul cannot restrain itself; it shall and must carry out the **LORD’S** work with zeal. Therefore, I say in good faith from my own gifts: a person should take great care if he intends or desires to speak with the **LORD’S** mouth. For if one wishes to say: "I, the living Word of **GOD**, speak and do this," then the **LORD’S** will must truly be present, and the Spirit of **GOD** must arm the tongue, heart, and mind, and move upon them Himself; otherwise, it is not the **LORD’S** word, but only the word of the outer man.

->Reflections on Stiefel <note>original: "Stief." Referring to Esaias Stiefel, a contemporary sectarian leader with whom the author often debated concerning the nature of Christ and the soul.</note> §. 85. 92.<-

II. Such a person should speak from no preconceived delusion, nor bring forth his own rational arguments; he must take great care that he does not overstep his mark by a single word in the **LORD'S** name. Instead, he must speak everything exactly as the Spirit of **GOD** places it in his mouth, so that he does not mingle his own spirit and mind with **GOD’S** Spirit, and thereby introduce a <term>Turba</term> <note>original: "Turbam." From Latin, meaning a disturbance or confusion. In Böhme’s theology, it refers to the awakening of God’s wrath or a disruption of the divine order.</note>, bringing himself into great temptation.

6. Question: Why is it that the prophets often present one and the same matter in such vastly different ways?

Answer: It is because the <term>Turba</term> is so multifaceted, and the various peoples exist in this or that <term>disposition</term> <note>original: "Qualificirung." The specific state or quality of a person's spiritual nature.</note>; furthermore, the soulish spirits of the prophets themselves are varied. The children of **GOD** have many different gifts, according to the rule of the Apostle: **GOD** gives to each to speak as He wills. The gifts of men all occur according to the unsearchable will of **GOD** and all spring from a single root, which is the mother of the three <term>principles</term> <note>The "three principles" refer to Böhme’s core cosmological framework: the dark fire-world (wrath), the light-world (love), and the outer world (nature).</note>. As the soulish spirit of each person is <term>constellated</term> in the eternal mother, so too is his revelation and knowledge. For **GOD** does not bring a new or foreign spirit into us; rather, He opens our own spirit with His Spirit,

<column-break/>

as the mystery of **God’s** wisdom, which lies within every human being, according to the measure and the manner of his own inner, hidden <term>constellation</term>. For **Christ** spoke: "My Father works, and I work also." Thus, the Father works in the <term>essence</term> of the soul’s own property, and the Son works in the <term>essence</term> of the inheritance of **GOD**, as in the Divine Godhead. The soulish property belongs to the Father; for Christ spoke: "Father, the men were yours, and you have given them to me, and I give them eternal life." <note>A paraphrasing of John 17:6.</note> Since the soulish property is from the Father from eternity, He has also worked within it from eternity, and works into eternity in that same image of light and darkness, wherever the soul’s property inclines its will. Since the Father's property is immeasurable—as He is Wisdom itself—and all things originated through His wisdom, the souls are <term>constellated</term> in many different ways. They originate from one <term>essence</term>, but the manifestation is varied, all according to **GOD’S** wisdom. Thus, the Spirit now opens the specific property of every soul, so that each speaks from its own property regarding the wonders within the wisdom of **GOD**.

**GOD'S** Spirit does not create anything new in man; rather, He speaks of the wonders in the wisdom of **GOD** out of the man, and this not only from the eternal [constellation], but also from the outer <term>constellation</term>, such as through the spirit of the world. He opens the soulish <term>constellation</term> in man, so that he must say what the outer heaven is working. He must speak through the <term>Great Turba</term> <note>original: "Turbam Magnam." The Great Disturbance or the awakening of judgment on a large scale.</note>, as the prophets often spoke, indicating the punishment that was to befall them through the <term>Great Turba</term> by **GOD’S** decree because of their sins. Thus, the Spirit of **GOD** often speaks in one person through the inner, eternal <term>constellation</term> of the soul.

# On the Revelation of GOD in the Prophets.

...eternal punishment or reward; and another speaks through his *Constellation* <note>original: "Constellation." In Böhme’s thought, this refers to the inner spiritual alignment or the specific makeup of a person's soul, mirroring the arrangement of the stars but occurring within.</note> of the luck and misfortune of this world, of the rise of all power, and also the breaking of lands and cities; **likewise** <note>original: "Item."</note> of the wondrous transformation of the world. And although it is true that the spirit of the outer world also often plays its game within man, and by its own power weaves itself into the human spirit and indicates its wondrous figure—which takes place in those who run merely in reason with a proud self-will—it is from this that false prophets often arise.

Therefore, I say now that each person speaks from his own *Constellation*: one speaks truly through the revelation of the Spirit of **GOD**; another speaks uncertainly through the opening of the outer stellar spirit, yet still from that same *Constellation*. But he who speaks of the mystery from another’s mouth and judges without his own understanding—that is **Babel** <note>In this context, Babel refers to a state of spiritual confusion or "empty chatter" where one repeats religious words without experiencing their power.</note> and delusion; it is a thing that the heart does not experience as being true.

And I say further, that all those precious men enlightened by **GOD**, whose writings you may partly have in hand, spoke from their own opening, each according to his own perception. But the **Center** <note>original: "Centrum."</note> is the soul, and the light is **GOD**; the revelation happens through the opening of the Spirit of **GOD**, through the *Constellation* of the soul.

From the beginning of the world, all prophets have prophesied of **Christ**, one in this way, another in that. They did not all use the same speech in the same **form** <note>original: "Forma."</note>, but each spoke as the Spirit of **GOD** opened to him in his eternal soulful *Constellation*; but they all spoke from one **Center**. Thus it still happens today: the children of **GOD** all speak from the opening of the Spirit of **Christ**, which is **GOD’S**, each according to his perception. Therefore, I would kindly remind you not to take offense at the chatter of reason and proud judgments, and thus despise anyone's gifts;

<column-break/>

for he who does so, despises the Spirit of **GOD**.

->Epistle 12. 25:33.<-

From this, we also see the true difference between the true prophets before the revelation of **JESUS Christ** in the flesh, under the Old Testament, and the true prophets in the New Covenant. The former spoke from the Spirit of **Christ** as from the promised Word that wished to move again in the flesh; yet no one was born anew in the flesh then, for the Word stood in the inner, faded image and opened itself with the voice through the outer <term>Mercury</term> <note>original: "Mercurium." Böhme uses the name of the planet/metal Mercury to describe the "active" or "speaking" power of the spirit that expresses thoughts and words.</note>, and showed the outer man what he would yet encounter when the Word of promise would reveal itself in the **Mercury** of the flesh, and therein break the loathing and death of the conflict within the forms of life.

But these, namely the prophets of the New Covenant, are driven by the Spirit of **JESUS Christ** to lead the old man, along with his lusts and desires, into death. They are driven to make the **Mercury**—which speaks and sounds from the old Adamite humanity and from the spirit of this world, indeed, from the **qualification** <note>original: "Qualificirung." The specific way a will or spirit takes on a certain quality or characteristic.</note> of the will in selfhood—mute and dumb. In contrast, they awaken the new life of **JESUS Christ** in the new birth, so that the **Mercury** sounds from the spirit and the new humanity of **JESUS Christ**. In an earnest wrestling with **GOD’S** wrath, in prayer, in intercession, in the offering of oneself for a people, land, city, **Age** <note>original: "Seculum."</note>, and the like, this spirit proves and reveals itself; such people are truly prophets of the New Covenant.

In contrast, those who everywhere awaken the <term>Turba</term> <note>original: "Turbam." The "Turba" is Böhme’s term for a state of spiritual disturbance, chaos, or the awakening of God’s wrath.</note>, inflame the wrath of **GOD**, and cause unrest and confusion—who at one moment carry **GOD’S** word and His precious name in their mouths, but at another moment, in their life and conduct, allow the powers of the dark world to rule in their own will and sin to rule in their flesh and blood—testify by their hearts that what they proclaim as **GOD’S** word is merely their own invention, self-deception, the inspiration of Satan, recantation, blasphemy, and rejection. They are to be considered more like sparks of fire from the **Turba** than true prophets. And earnest lovers of truth must be careful, for we stand in the time of the last seal, where all **Principles** <note>original: "Principia." The fundamental spiritual foundations of reality.</note> stand in a very strong and sharp-pulling hunger, each according to all seven properties of nature; and especially **Mercury** is in the property of **Venus**...

This harlot-child has now become at odds with itself over the great robbery and plunder, and it reveals its own vices and great shame, so that we may see what "good" was truly in her. She cries *Racha* <note>original: "Racha." A biblical term of contempt (Matthew 5:22).</note> and "murder" over heresy, and yet she is not concerned for GOD, but for her own harlot’s-brood. **10. Question:** How will the **Roman** *Monarchy*, or the present government, fall and break apart?

**Answer:** We have mentioned above how secular government was born out of the ignition of **GOD'S** wrath after the Fall of man, and how a mighty tree grew from it, overshadowing everything and drawing the sap and strength of all plants out of nature with its harsh quality. Now, eternal nature seeks a limit to such grim torment, violence, and power of fire within the "children of love." Through their imagination, they drive from anxiety and constraint toward freedom. In such a driving, they introduce the <term>Turba</term> <note>Latin for "disturbance" or "uproar"; in Böhme’s philosophy, it refers to the disruptive power of divine wrath that breaks down corrupted or "self-willed" structures.</note> into the secular government, so that the *Turba* might consume the growth, and dry up and hinder the blossoming grimness and wrath of **GOD**, so that the plant and all its branches wither from the root up. For the Will of Love desires a purity without the *Turba* in another being. When this Will becomes active, the power of the Love-Will moves over the grimness and holds it in constraint; but the grimness seeks to escape the Love and will not surrender itself to Love. Therefore, there is a mighty strife between the **Kingdom of GOD** and the kingdom of this world; hence such wonderful *movements* and birth pangs arise. At times, the wrath and its government exalt themselves over Love and seek to ruin and destroy the children of peace; but then, when the anxiety in the children of **GOD** becomes powerful, the Spirit drives with great force toward freedom and seeks the goal of the Driver, wanting to be rid of the constraint. Thus, the goal is sought by all creatures, which remains hidden in the <term>Mysterium</term> <note>The "Mystery" or the hidden spiritual ground of reality.</note>. And thus, and from this, originates all the violence of this world—that one always rules over another. This was not commanded or ordered by the Highest Good in the beginning, but grew out of the *Turba*, which nature later recognized as its own essence because it was born from it, and gave it laws to reproduce itself further in a structured government. This "birth" then climbed until it reached **Royal** *Majesty*, and further sought the "Abyss" as a unity, until it became a *Monarchy*, such as an Empire. And as it still...

**11. Question:** So much for the fall of Babylon <note>original: "Babel." In this context, Babylon symbolizes the confused and corrupt state of the worldly church and political systems.</note> and the Anti-Christ; how then shall Zion finally be raised up, and the **Time of the Lily** <note>The "Lily-Time" is Böhme's term for a future golden age of spiritual peace and true knowledge of God on earth.</note> begin?

**Answer:** Just as the time of flowers and the spring is born out of winter, and the former does not break forth until the latter dies away; so Zion is born in Babylon, and the Lily-Time takes its beginning amidst many storm-winds, great movements, war, and rumors of war, and many revolutions in worldly government, as well as in great persecutions and heavy tribulations. In those sorrowful times of our Author, within the hearts of many anxious and persecuted members of Christ, the little seed-grain of the Kingdom of GOD was internally unlocked, and the kindling of its life began. This growth has now, over a hundred years, through indescribable storms and tribulations, broken through more and more, and has been in a powerful movement here and there; it has also now and then revealed itself in many green and magnificent branches, which then, in the harsh and severe winter-time—when the days are short, the power of darkness great, love grown cold, and the wrath of GOD has become mighty—the leaves fell off again, and many a tender little branch that did not draw enough life and sap into itself faded and died. Meanwhile, however, the growth from the root of the Spirit of Jesus always pushes forth new branches, which green forth in the Kingdom of

<column-break/>

GOD, bearing flowers and fruits that reveal and prove the power of the Kingdom of GOD through their color, scent, taste, and virtue. Although many a little branch dies here and there from the bitter cold, another—which sets its will with more earnestness into the root of the tree—breaks through all the ice and storm-wind all the more magnificently. As we have seen the little tree greening lovelily in these our latter times, yet at present in this earnest time of testing, many a branch that was not rooted deep into the fiery heart of love of JESUS Christ, and did not lean firmly upon the Wellspring of the Living and Seeing One, withers again. But we believe that when the Sun of JESUS Christ and its astral power, which rekindles itself in the root of the growth, soon comes into movement again, it will break through so powerfully that much which now appears as if dead shall green and sprout once more, until finally the growth reaches its goal and crown, and the Lily-Time becomes manifest.

The Lily will green through the "dug-through tables of Moses" <note>This refers to a spiritual understanding of the Law/Ten Commandments, where the "stony" letter of the law is penetrated by the spirit.</note> with its strong scent, which will smell of the Paradise of GOD; by which power the peoples will become so mighty and strong that they will leave the Anti-Christ and run through the darkness toward the scent of the flower; for the **Breaker-through-the-doors-of-the-deep** has planted the Lily and has given it into the hands of the noble virgins; and it grows in the element in wonder, against the terrifying storm of hell and the realm of this world. Then many branches fall to the ground, by which the Anti-Christ is blinded, and becomes quite mad and insane in the vapor and mist, and stirs the four elements into wrath. **12. Question:** What does the Author actually understand by the **Time of the Lily**?

**Answer:** Nothing other than that time when the life and the spirit of *JESUS Christ* shall break through in all true believers, over all power of darkness and wrath, completely destroying sin in the flesh, and shall flourish and green forth in righteousness, peace, and joy.

**13. Question:** Does the Author not perhaps understand by the **Time of the Lily** or the **Golden Age** <note>original: "Aureum Seculum," Latin for "Golden Age."</note> the thousand-year glorious kingdom of *JESUS Christ*, of which it is written in the Revelation of John?

**Answer:** As far as the so-called thousand-year kingdom of Christ is concerned, as written in the *Apocalypse* <note>original: "Apocalypsi," the Book of Revelation.</note>, and how it is presented in these modern times by many writers with all its circumstances, our Author did not have a sufficient knowledge of it. He did not absolutely contradict it, but rather opened up his reflections on it, leaving it to each person to distinguish for themselves. We set down here his reflections which he raised concerning this in an Epistle <note>original: "Send-Brieff."</note> to one of his good friends, for the reader's further contemplation and earnest testing. The Author indeed believes in a **Golden Age** and a **Time of the Lily**, but not universally and in all places, but only in true living believers; not as if the godly will first arise from the dead, and together with the godly who have remained, govern for a thou-

<column-break/>

sand years in a physical manner, and only then the judgment be held. Rather, he believes that the life of *JESUS Christ* shall green forth in the saints who will be upon the earth, but in the ungodly, the power of wrath shall be no less mighty; for wickedness shall trickle <note>or "seep/drip."</note> until the end. And although there will be a **Zion**, it is nevertheless not universal; it will only break **Babylon** <note>original: "Babel."</note> and take on another form; but not all who call themselves children of Zion will be children of **GOD**.

"Also, I have no knowledge of the thousand-year Sabbath, nor do I know how to ground it sufficiently in the Scriptures, for one always finds the opposite; one can interpret the Scripture however one wishes. Since I then have no command from **GOD** regarding this, I let it stand, and leave to each person their opinion upon their own responsibility. I join myself to you as a sincere well-wisher, and am otherwise related to you in the love of Christ in faithfulness. In this time, a Zion will indeed be found, and the earth shall give its fatness, but not in such a way as if wickedness would be entirely gone; for it shall trickle until the end, of which *Christ* says: 'Do you think that faith will be found on earth when the Son of Man comes?' And although a fiery rescue shall happen for the children of Zion, so that they will remain against the Devil’s will, and although **GOD** will work great things, as in the *time of the Apostles*, it nonetheless does not last until the end; for as it was in the time of *Noah*, when he went into the Ark, so also shall be the coming of the Son of Man, as it is written. But that the Holy Spirit shall be in Zion, in the hearts of believers, I confess and know; for Zion will not be from the outside, but in the **new man**. It is already born; whoever wishes to seek it, let him only seek himself, and go out from the **old Adam** <note>The fallen, sinful nature of humanity.</note> into a new life; he will find it, whether *JESUS* be born in him. 11. **Question:** So much concerning the fall of Babylon <note>original: "Babel," referring to the confused state of worldly religious and political institutions.</note> and the Anti-Christ; how then shall Zion finally be established, and the **Time of the Lily** <note>A term used by Böhme to describe a future age of spiritual purity and peace.</note> break forth?

**Answer:** Just as the time of flowers and the spring is born out of winter—and the former does not break forth until the latter dies away—so Zion is born within Babylon. The Time of the Lily begins amidst many storm-winds, great movements, war, and rumors of war, and many revolutions in worldly governance, as well as great persecutions and heavy tribulations. In those sorrowful times of our Author, within the hearts of many anxious and persecuted members of Christ, the seed-grain of the Kingdom of GOD opened up internally and its life began to ignite. This plant has now, over a hundred years through indescribable storms and tribulations, continued to break through, and has been in a powerful state of growth here and there. It has also revealed itself now and then in many green and glorious branches, which then—in the harsh and severe winter-time, when the days are short, the power of darkness is great, love has grown cold, and the fury of GOD’S wrath has become mighty—dropped their leaves again. Many a tender little branch, which did not draw enough life and sap into itself, withered and died. Meanwhile, however, the plant continues to push forth new branches from the root of the Spirit of JESUS, which green forth in the Kingdom of GOD...

### 12. Question: What does the author actually mean by the **Time of the Lily**?

**Answer:** Nothing other than that time when the life and the Spirit of JESUS Christ shall break through in all true believers, over all the power of darkness and wrath, completely rooting out sin in the flesh, and flourishing and turning green in righteousness, peace, and joy.

### 13. Question: Does the author, by the **Time of the Lily** or the **Golden Age** <note>original Latin: "Aureum Seculum"</note>, not perhaps mean the thousand-year glorious Kingdom of JESUS Christ, as described in the Revelation of John?

**Answer:** Concerning the so-called thousand-year Kingdom of Christ, as described in the Apocalypse <note>The Book of Revelation.</note>, and as it is presented with all its circumstances by many writers <note>original: "Scribenten"</note> in these modern times, our author did not have sufficient knowledge of it. He did not contradict it so absolutely, but rather opened up his reflections regarding it, leaving it to everyone to distinguish for themselves. We provide here his reflection, which he raised in an **Epistle** <note>original: "Send-Brieff"</note> to one of his good friends, for the reader's further consideration and earnest testing. The author indeed believes in a **Golden Age** <note>original: "Aureum Seculum"</note> and a **Time of the Lily**, but not universally and in all places, but only in true living believers; not as if first the godly will rise from the dead and, along with those remaining, reign for a

<column-break/>

thousand years in a bodily manner, after which the judgment would first be held. Rather, he believes that the life of JESUS Christ will grow green in the saints who shall be on earth, while in the ungodly the power of wrath will be no less mighty; for wickedness shall trickle until the end. And although a **Zion** <note>A symbolic name for the true, spiritual church or the presence of God among people.</note> will exist, it is yet not universal; only **Babylon** <note>original: "Babel," referring to the confused and corrupt state of institutional religion and worldly systems.</note> will break and take on another form, but not all who call themselves children of Zion will be children of GOD.

Also, I have no knowledge of the thousand-year Sabbath, nor can I find enough grounding for it in the Scripture; for one always finds the opposite, and one can interpret the Scripture however one wishes. Since I then have no command from GOD regarding this, I let it be, and leave everyone to their own opinion on their own responsibility. I address you as a faithful well-wisher and am otherwise related to you in the love of Christ in faithfulness. In this time, a Zion will indeed be found, and the earth will give its fatness, but not in such a way that wickedness would be entirely gone, for it shall trickle until the end, of which Christ says: "Do you think that faith will be found on earth when the Son of Man comes?" And though a fiery rescue shall happen for the children of Zion, so that they will remain against the Devil’s will, and GOD will work great things as in the time of the Apostles, yet it does not last until the end; for as it was in the time of Noah, when he entered the Ark, so also shall be the coming of the Son of Man, as it is written. But that the Holy Spirit will be in Zion within the hearts of believers, I confess and know; for Zion will not be from the outside, but in the **new man** <note>The spiritually reborn nature of a person.</note>. He who wishes to seek this is already born; let him only seek himself, and go out from the **old Adam** <note>The fallen, sinful nature of humanity inherited from the first man.</note> into a new life. He will find whether JESUS is born in him; if he does not find that, let him only go into himself, and he will find Babylon and its workings within himself.

And if one wanted to interpret Christ's words regarding His coming differently, it would still not be enough to prove it, since Christ’s disciples also always [represented] the end as near...

### Part 4 / Chapter 16.

[...see] it, then no godless person can either see or grasp the same, just as we now do not see **Paradise**; likewise is the new body also, against which no godless person can struggle—or why would they want to struggle? If the saints are in **Paradise**, they have no need of the **four elements** <note>In Böhme’s cosmology, the "four elements" (fire, air, water, earth) constitute the physical world of conflict. The "inner element" is the pure, unified divine substance.</note>, but only of the inner element, where all four lie as One; thus they have nothing to fight for, but are separated in their quality. Should the godless then die, and should they also rise again in the four elements? That appears far more strange. But if they should rise in a spiritual body, then that body cannot grasp the four elements, but rather the **Abyss** <note>The "Abyss" (Abgrund) refers to the dark, chaotic foundation of nature, which becomes the state of hell for those separated from God's light.</note>, and they would yet be separated, like light and darkness.

What pleasure would GOD have in this: that he would want to lead the most holy ones back into the strife and into the torment of the four elements, to which they have already died? And should they first go into battle with the godless? Rather, it would be more fitting for the others to do so—those who suffered nothing for Christ's sake here on earth—than for those who lost their lives here on earth for Christ's sake.

And if one were to say: they will not fight, but the LORD for them—what pleasure would GOD have in waking the saints and placing them before the eyes of the godless again? Or might the joy in **Abraham's Bosom** <note>A biblical term for the place of comfort where the righteous dead await the resurrection.</note> not be greater than this in the four elements, where by nature there is strife? But if they are to dwell in Paradise outside of the four elements, then no strife can touch them, nor any godless person. Furthermore, of what use would the godless be on earth, if it is to be a **Sabbath**? For their torment is not in the four elements, but in the Abyss, where their soul goes when the body dies. Moreover, if only those who had died for Christ's sake were to dwell in the Sabbath, there might not be such a number of them (as it says in the **Apocalypse** <note>The Book of Revelation.</note>) that they should inhabit the whole earth; and should the godless also dwell on earth and keep a hellish Sabbath? All of which runs 

<column-break/>

against the **light of nature** <note>The "light of nature" (Licht der Natur) is a key concept for Böhme, referring to the innate spiritual intelligence or common sense granted to humanity to understand the world.</note>. Furthermore, Christ says: *They will marry and be given in marriage, as in the days of Noah*; also, *two of them shall be grinding in a mill, and two of them shall be sleeping in one bed, and one shall be taken, and the other left*, when the **Last Day** comes. Furthermore, Christ also says that when he comes to judge the world, all generations shall see him and be terrified before him, and the godless will weep and howl, and say to the **wise virgins**: *give us some of your oil*. 

All of this indicates a general waiting for the **Last Judgment**; for then, at the last trumpet, two of them shall lie in one bed—one holy and one godless—which indicates no separation [until then]. If the saints were to mingle with the godless, it would surely be a poor Sabbath. When one looks at the words of Christ and his apostles, they simply do not want to fit that [millennialist] view, even though a **thousand-year Sabbath** is written in the Apocalypse; but that is hidden from us, and we do not know when it may begin, or if it has begun already. 

If the first resurrection is Paradisiacal, then it could well have happened without our knowledge. They would not dwell among us, nor would they be given in marriage; for we die once to the state of husband and wife, and we shall not rise again as husband and wife, but we shall live in **Angelic form** in Paradise (**Matthew 13 and 22**). Furthermore, the godless shall ask the wise for the oil of faith, at the appearance of his coming; and yet you write that the fire of GOD—as the wrath and hellish torment—shall be within them, and they shall be tormented on earth in the four elements in the wrath of GOD, and yet the wrath of GOD is not manifest in the four elements, for evil and good are mixed together. But how will he, who has once died to the Good and can have no good thoughts, even think to ask the saints for faith and comfort? This indicates much more that when Christ comes...

# Of the Revelation of GOD in the Prophets.

... [ta]ken <note>original: "men wird"; completing the sentence from the previous page: "one will be taken."</note> to judge the world; they will all still dwell among one another in the flesh in the **four elements** <term>four elements: fire, air, water, and earth, which Böhme believes make up our temporary, physical world of conflict</term>, where one will be taken and the other left, and the sin of the godless will appear before their eyes in the appearance of the stern face of **GOD**, in the fire-zeal of the **First Principle** <term>First Principle: the foundational, fiery "wrathful" side of God's nature, which is transformed into light for the holy but remains a consuming fire for the godless</term>, so that they will be terrified and only then want to become pious. And though you may say they shall only wake up and not rise; yet one would have to understand those as incorruptible; yet you say they shall dwell on earth in the elements, and the saints in **Paradise**. If that is so, then no more conflict occurs, but they are eternally separated. But if the saints are to dwell on earth in **Paradise**, like **Adam** before the Fall, and the godless are to stand against them, then there is danger for them, as with Adam, that they might again eat of earthly fruit, from which they would die once more. But if they are to be hidden from the godless for a thousand years, and also from the four elements, why then should they first be revealed in the elements at the end? That **Gog and Magog** <note>In the Bible, Gog and Magog represent the ultimate enemies of God's people who gather for a final battle at the end of time.</note> should first struggle with the **Paradise-children**, that aligns neither with **Scripture** nor with reason.

The **First Epistle to the Corinthians**, chapter 15, does indeed teach of **Christ's** and our resurrection, but not of three, rather of **Christ’s**, and then of ours; for there he says: *The first-fruits is Christ, and afterward we, who belong to Christ* <note>original: "Der Erſtling iſt Christus / und darnach wir / die wir Chriſtum angehören"</note>; That is the general resurrection, and though he says "then the end," he mentions no resurrection along with the end; rather, the end is our resurrection; that is to be understood more as the end than that he meant another resurrection or time with "the end," for after our resurrection comes the end of this world. The dead shall first step before the judgment before the end of this world with the four elements comes, for the end is the ignition of the fire, and the final thing.

<column-break/>

Also, **Christ's** Apostles and all teachers of **GOD** have always portrayed the end as being near to us; For **John** in his Epistle says himself that we are at the end; He certainly speaks of the last hour; but if the godless person were certain that he still had four hundred years <note>While the text says "four hundred," the context of the Millennial debate usually concerns the 1,000-year period.</note> until the end, how he would strive after his children and wealth! Also, the end is well worth our reflection: For this world is enclosed in the beginning of creation, and then in the end; where the creation ceased, that was all completed in six days, and in such a time shall the mystery of the **Kingdom of GOD** be completed, and before **GOD** a thousand years is like a day. But as concerns the **seventh day of rest**, whether the world shall still stand for a thousand years in rest, is hidden from us humans; we cannot conclude with certainty; we must leave it to His power. I also have no knowledge of this, because Scripture does not clearly provide when the thousand years begin, or what kind of years they are, or what the circumstances are; so I leave it at its value, but I would not want to have prevented anyone if they had a certain knowledge or command to deal with it; I add this for you to reflect upon in good intention. But whatever more might be answered to this, you will find enough in my writings; Although I might well provide a detailed answer, it did not seem to me to be enough, because this knowledge has not been given to me; I therefore let it stand, for I know that I shall give an account of my affairs.

### Part 4 / Chapter 16

...move the ignition of the spirit. But investigate within the **Light of Nature** <term>Light of Nature: A concept in Böhme’s philosophy meaning the innate intelligence found within the created world, which reflects divine truths</term> whether you can find a foundation for this. If you can ground and reach this within the light of eternal nature, then you may well proceed; but demonstrate it to us so that we may see it; otherwise, our mind cannot rest upon it unless it finds a foundation. It also cannot be proven with scriptures that might be pulled into the argument; for they also provide the opposite view and can quite easily be interpreted differently. If my mind had not turned toward the love and rest of **Christ** <note>original: "CHristi"</note>, I would show it to you in the manner of this current **quarrelsome world** <note>Böhme refers to the bitter theological disputes of the 17th century</note>.

The **Revelation** <note>original: "Apocalypsis"</note> is spiritual and is hidden within the **Mystery** <note>original: "Mysterio"</note>; it requires a highly enlightened mind and understanding that has the power to reach into the **Mystery of GOD**. It speaks magically; thus, a magical understanding is required for it. In this [literal] manner, I do not find the magical concept, for it is merely a historical concept. He who wishes to approach **Magic** <note>original: "Magiam"</note> in a heavenly way must recognize the heavenly figures, the shape of the inner heaven, as the **Center** or **Life-Circle** <note>original: "Circul"</note> from which all beings originate and from which this world is born. But if he does not have that same magical guide within himself, let him leave the heavenly figures alone, or else the **Great Turba** <term>Great Turba: The spirit of wrath, disruption, or "noise" that brings chaos to those who overstep their spiritual bounds</term> will have the power to vomit him out of the **Divine Magic**.

John the Evangelist, or whoever wrote the **Revelation**, recognized the figure of the **Magic of GOD**; although he himself reports that he was led into it and it was shown to him. Therefore, those same figures have remained standing within the **Divine Magic**. And although they manifest themselves, a specific type of **Magus** <term>Magus: Not a sorcerer, but a spiritually "wise man" who understands how the divine will operates in the world</term> is required—one who understands the **little treasury** <note>original: "Thesaurinellam"; a spiritual key or inner storehouse of wisdom</note>. He must understand all **three Principles** <term>three Principles: Böhme’s system of the Dark World (fire), the Light World (love), and the Outward World (nature)</term> with their figures; only then does he have authority. Otherwise, his work falls prey to the **Turba**; I speak this with quite well-meaning intent. If it pleases you, read my book *The Threefold Life* correctly; there

<column-break/>

you will find the root of **Magic**, although many other much deeper roots are present. I would wish that you might understand that book, for it has enough foundation; otherwise, you might not grasp the others. If it then pleases you to search further, you can certainly attain them; only there must be **earnestness** involved, otherwise they remain silent. For the foundation of the same is highly magical, as the enlightened mind will surely find if it immerses itself within it. The **Revelation** is quite easy to understand therein, and in no other way will it be fully understood except from the **Mystery of GOD**. Whoever is willing to immerse himself in that finds everything he seeks. I would therefore like you to test your "ignition" <note>Referring to the spark of spiritual inspiration</note>, so that you might recognize the guide from the inner world and also the guide from the outer world, so that the **magical school** of both worlds might be known to you; then the noble mind would be free from **delusion**. For in delusion there is no perfection; the spirit must be capable of the **Mystery**, so that God's Spirit is the guide in his vision. Otherwise, he stands only in the outer **Mystery**, as in the outer heaven of the **stars** <note>original: "Gestirnes"; Böhme often links the physical stars to a lower, limited form of knowledge</note>, which also often vehemently ignites and drives the human mind; but it does not have the **Divine magical school**, which exists only in a simple, childlike mind. The outer guide works and shines only in the **mirror**; but the inner guide shines in the **essence** <note>original: "Wesen"</note>, which he cannot do unless God’s Spirit leads him. Therefore, he stands well with **GOD** whom the heavenly school seizes; he will become a **Magus** without his own hard running, if he is seized by **GOD** and driven by the **Holy Spirit**.

Therefore, a person should examine himself: by which guide is he seized? Does he find that he has the **Divine Light** shining in his vision? Does his guide lead him on the path of truth, toward love and righteousness, into the heavenly school?

### Part 4 / Chapter 17.

This kingdom does not reach into eternity; rather, it was born out of the [divine] Element at the time of the ignition of the **Fiat** <note>original: "Fiats"; the divine creative command "Let there be," which Böhme views as a formative power that shaped the physical world</note>. It is now fragile and has a fixed **Seculum** <note>Latin: age, lifespan, or era</note>, goal, and time. Likewise, this same **Region** <note>realm or dominion</note> exists within the soul; when the light of life is ignited, it has a fixed **Seculum** and time for its breaking apart. This kingdom raises the human being and provides the tormenting qualities of their habits, will, and desire for both good and evil. It places the person in beauty, glory, wealth, and honor, making an earthly god out of them. It reveals great wonders within them and runs with them without hesitation until their **Seculum** and end is reached, at which point it separates from them. And just as it helped the human in life, it also helps them in death by breaking away from the soul.

First, the four **Elementa** <note>the four physical elements: earth, air, fire, and water</note> break away from the [eternal] Element; then the tormenting within the third **Principio** <note>Principle; for Böhme, the "third principle" is the visible, material world</note> ceases. The most terrifying part is when the four **Elementa** break within themselves; this is death—the point when the **Sulfur-Spirit** <term>Sulfur-Spirit: In Böhme's alchemy, "Sulfur" represents the active, burning life-force or the "soul" of the physical body that drives the senses.</term>—which originates from the gall <note>bile</note> and ignites the heart's **Tinctur** <term>Tincture: The spiritual essence or "color" of life that mediates between the soul and the physical body.</term>—is suffocated. Then the **Tinctur**, along with the shadow of the human being's essence, enters the **Æther** <note>The subtle "upper air" or spiritual space</note> and remains as a shadow in the root of the Element from which the four **Elementa** were born and proceeded. Within this remains only the pain of the breaking apart, by which a "house of torment" is broken off from the soul. However, if the essences of the soul from the first **Principio** <note>The dark, fiery foundation of the soul's existence</note> have become so deeply attached to the **Region** of this world that the soul's essences sought only the pleasures of this world—temporal honor, power, and splendor—then the soul (or the essences from the first **Principio**) still clings to the starry **Region** as its most beloved treasure, willing to live within it. But since it no longer has its mother (the four **Elementa**), it eventually consumes itself within the essences of the first **Principio**, and the essences of the first **Principio** remain raw.

3. Question: How does the soul separate from the body?

**Answer:** Because man is so very earthly, he has almost only earthly knowledge (unless he is reborn in the "Gates of the Deep"). He always thinks the soul simply flies out of the mouth when the body dies, understanding nothing of its deep essences that exist beyond the **Elementa**. When someone sees a blue beam departing from a person’s mouth as they die, which causes a strong odor throughout the room, they imagine that this is the soul. Oh no, dear soul, it is not! The soul is not seen or grasped in the outer elements. Rather, that is the **Sulfur-Spirit**, the spirit of the third **Principio**. It is just like when you blow out a candle: a smoke and a stench arise that were not there while the candle was burning. It is the same here: when the light of the body breaks, the **Sulfur-Spirit** suffocates, and its vapor and deadly stench depart with its tormenting poison.

Understand this rightly: it is the tormenting spirit from the gall that ignites the heart (which keeps life in motion) that suffocates when the **Tinctur** in the heart’s blood is extinguished. The true soul requires no such exit; it is many times more subtle than the **Sulfur-Spirit**, even though they exist as one being during the body's lifetime. But when the spirit of the four elements departs, the true soul—which was breathed into Adam—remains standing in its own **Principio**. For it is so subtle that nothing can grasp it; it passes through flesh and bone, even wood and stone, and breaks none of them.

->Princ. 19. 18. 20.<-

**Question 5.** Where then do the souls of those go, who have completed their sanctification here in the fear of GOD, or in whom the rebirth and the life of JESUS Christ have become powerful and effective?

**Answer.** We have just demonstrated that the soul does not depart through the mouth, for it did not enter through the mouth; rather, it merely steps out of the earthly life. The *Turba* <note>original: "Turba" - a term used by the author to describe the inward "turmoil" or the "wrath of God" that breaks down and destroys the physical form.</note> breaks off the earthly life, so the soul remains standing in its own **Principle** <note>original: "Principio" - referring to one of the spiritual realms of existence.</note>. For the body does not contain it; neither wood nor stone can grasp it; it is thinner than the air. And if it possesses GOD’S body, it passes easily like a knight through the *Turba*, as if through the wrath of GOD and through death; and once it is through, it is within the essence of GOD. It remains with the wonders and the essence it created here; it sees GOD’S majesty and the angels face to face. Wherever it is, it is in the bottomless world where there is no end nor limit. Where should it go? "Where a carcass is, there the eagles gather" <note>A reference to Matthew 24:28, implying the soul is naturally drawn to its source, Christ.</note>; it is in Christ’s flesh and blood, with Christ its shepherd. And even if it were to travel a thousand miles, it would still be at the place from which it departed; for in GOD there is no limit—near and far are one and the same thing. It is as fast as a human thought; it is **magical**; it dwells in its wonders, which is its house. The essence outside of it is Paradise: a greening, blooming, and growing of all beautiful heavenly fruits. Just as we have all sorts of fruits in this world from which we eat earthly food, so too are there all sorts of fruits in Paradise that the soul may eat. They exist in color and power as actual essence, not merely as a thought; yet they are as thin and subtle as a thought, though substantial, perceptible to the soul, feelable, powerful, and juicy from the Water of Life—all

<column-break/>

from the heavenly essence. For the heavenly body of the soul is made of the pure **Element** <note>In this mystical context, the "Element" refers to the singular, divine source-material from which the four worldly elements were born.</note> from which the four elements were brought forth, and it provides flesh; and the **Tincture** <note>original: "Tincktur" - the spiritual essence or "life-force" that gives quality and vitality to being.</note> provides blood. The heavenly man is in flesh and blood, and Paradise is the power of the essence: it is heavenly earth, not graspable by our external reason.

Those who have suffered much persecution for the sake of the truth see their beautiful little knight’s wreath, which they shall place upon their new body on the Last Day. Those who have done much good see it appearing before their eyes in the will. And those who have been mocked, scorned, killed, and persecuted for the sake of Christ’s honor, teaching, and truth find the knightly victory before their eyes, just like one who has overcome his enemies in a battle and presents the victory to his king and prince; in this, he has great honor, for his king receives him with great joy and keeps him as his faithful helper. They wait for the Last Day with great joy and honor, when their works will appear before their eyes in heavenly form, and the ungodly shall see "whom they have pierced." <note>A biblical reference to Zechariah 12:10 and John 19:37, regarding the recognition of Christ by his persecutors.</note> Every soul rejoices in great hope before GOD’S countenance for that which shall happen to it; for it recognizes its reward, but cannot grasp it without a body. 7. Question: What happens, however, to those souls who spent their lifetime here in many sins, but turn to God at the very end, and take hold of Christ their Redeemer with hope in faith in their final hour of death? See Principles, Chapter 19. 41 to 53.

**Answer:** Those souls who are thus stained with coarse sins and never truly entered into the **earnest birth** <note>Böhme’s term for the difficult, sincere process of spiritual rebirth</note>, and yet clung to it somewhat—as often happens with those burdened with worldly honor and profit, where sometimes personal power and self-interest pass for justice, and where malice, not wisdom, is the judge; there, much is loaded upon the poor soul, and yet the poor soul would also gladly be saved. Then the person comes and prays to **GOD** for the forgiveness of sins, while the fox hangs onto the back of his cloak <note>A metaphor for lingering worldly greed or deceitful habits that the person refuses to let go of even while praying</note>; he wishes to be justified, but his unrighteousness sticks in the abyss; it does not let him into the new rebirth, for his spirit has possessed him too much. His false **Babel** <note>The confused, worldly religious systems</note> arising from the Antichrist’s way of thinking does not permit him a right, earnest conversion; it shuts the gates of love; the spirit of this world and the addiction to the flesh remains the *Primas* <note>original: "Primas" - the primary or ruling principle</note> at all times. And then, nonetheless, when the hour of death

<column-break/>

comes, so that the consciences awake, and the poor soul gasps in great fear of the torment of Hell, then one would also gladly be saved; yet there is little faith there, but rather vain unrighteousness, falsehood, and the lust of earthly life. The sighing and tears of the poor <note>Those whom the sinner oppressed during life</note> stand harshly before him; the devil reads to the mind the book of its conscience. Then the lustful world also stands before it, and it would gladly live longer, promising indeed to lead its way in **abstinence**; its mind does indeed attach itself somewhat to **GOD**, but its sins strike that back down again, and great doubt arises in unrest; nevertheless, many a soul seafaring through this takes hold of the Savior by a thread.

When death then comes and separates the body and soul from one another, the poor soul hangs by that thread and will not let go; and its **essences** <note>The fundamental spiritual qualities or "being" of the soul</note> still stick fast in **GOD’s** wrath; the torment of coarse sins plagues it; the thread of faith in the new birth is very weak. One must then press through the gates of the deep, through the suffering and death of **Christ**, and through the kingdom of Hell to reach **GOD**—and Hell still has a great bond upon the soul; the falsehood is not yet washed away. Then the Bridegroom speaks: Come! But the poor soul speaks: I cannot yet; my lamp is still untrimmed; nevertheless, it holds the Savior by the thread and further places its **imagination** <note>The soul's power to form its internal reality and focus its desire</note> through the thread of faith and confidence into the heart of **GOD**, whereby it is finally **ransomed** <note>original: "ranzioniret"</note> out of the **putrefaction** <note>original: "Putrefaction" - here referring to a state of spiritual purification or the breaking down of the old, sinful nature</note> through the suffering of **Christ**.
